title: Quetzalcoatlite as a Disorder-Free Platform for Chiral Magnetism and Frustration
comment: 9 Pages, including 6 Figures, and additional four pages of Supplementary Information
summary: The natural mineral quetzalcoatlite Zn$_6$Cu$_3$(TeO$_6$)$_2$(OH)$_6$ $\cdot$ (Ag$_x$Pb$_y$Cl$_{x+2y}$) is a structurally ideal kagome magnet, providing a platform for exploring the interplay of geometric frustration, chirality, and tunability in a disorder-free framework. Here, we present the (first) comprehensive ab initio study of its electronic and magnetic properties. The electronic structure is dominated by localized half-filled Cu $d_{x^2-y^2}$ orbitals that become insulating through electronic correlations. Mapping the low-energy physics onto a Heisenberg model reveals that the magnetism is governed primarily by two exchange interactions: a nearest-neighbor intralayer kagome coupling and a next-nearest-neighbor interlayer coupling. Their competition stabilizes an unconventional three-dimensional chiral magnetic state. Each kagome layer hosts a $\sqrt{3}\times\sqrt{3}$ order, while adjacent layers are rotated by $60^\circ$, producing a right-handed spiral along the crystallographic $c$-axis. This intrinsic chiral order emerges naturally from the crystal structure and magnetic interactions, establishing quetzalcoatlite as a distinctive realization of chiral magnetism on a perfect kagome lattice. At the same time, the small energy scale of the exchange interactions places the material close to competing magnetic regimes, suggesting that moderate pressure, chemical substitution, or structural modifications may strongly enhance frustration, suppress long-range order, and potentially drive the system toward a quantum spin-liquid state.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对天然矿物quetzalcoatlite进行了全面的从头算研究，发现其电子结构由局域化的半填充Cu d轨道主导，通过电子关联形成绝缘体。将其低能物理映射到Heisenberg模型后，发现两个竞争性交换相互作用（层内kagome最近邻耦合和层间次近邻耦合）稳定了一种非常规的三维手性磁态，每层呈现√3×√3序，相邻层旋转60°形成沿c轴右手螺旋。这种固有手性磁序自然涌现自晶体结构与磁相互作用，同时小的交换能标使该材料接近竞争性磁序，有望通过压力或化学替换驱动其进入量子自旋液体态。
AI.motivation: quetzalcoatlite是一种结构上理想的kagome磁体，为在无无序框架中探索几何阻挫、手性和可调谐性之间的相互作用提供了平台。作者旨在通过从头算研究揭示其电子和磁性性质，填补该材料缺乏系统性理论研究的空白。
AI.method: 采用从头算（ab initio）方法研究电子结构，识别出局域化半填充Cu d_{x^2-y^2}轨道通过电子关联导致绝缘行为。将低能物理映射到Heisenberg自旋模型，提取关键的磁交换相互作用参数，并通过自旋模型分析确定磁性基态的构型。
AI.result: 确定了两个主导的交换相互作用（层内kagome最近邻和层间次近邻），它们的竞争稳定了一个三维手性磁态：每层为√3×√3磁序，相邻层旋转60°，沿c轴形成右手螺旋。交换相互作用的能标很小，使材料接近多个竞争磁序的边界。
AI.conclusion: quetzalcoatlite是完美kagome晶格上手性磁性的独特实现，其小交换能标意味着可通过适度压力、化学替换或结构修饰增强阻挫、抑制长程序，可能驱动系统进入量子自旋液体态，为研究几何阻挫与手性物理提供了理想平台。

title: The Fate of Crystalline Topological Phenomena in the Continuum
summary: The continuum limit is a widely used theoretical construct for obtaining continuum field-theories of crystalline systems. We study the formulation of a continuum limit for gapped bosonic phases and ask whether their topological properties survive passage to the continuum. Using methods in algebraic topology and category theory, we give a rigorous formulation of the continuum limit and construct a surjective global map relating crystalline topological phases across all finite point-group symmetries to continuum invertible topological phases. Consequently, we find that some lattice phases admit no continuum limit, while distinct lattice phases that do admit a continuum limit can share the same continuum image, hence implying that some lattice topological data can collapse. Conversely, we find that every continuum invertible phase admits a faithful crystalline realization. In addition to the general framework, we apply it to several examples, including studies of a 2D rotation-symmetric phase, higher-order topological phases, and the mixed spin-lattice anomaly of the deconfined quantum critical point between an antiferromagnet and valence bond solid.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了有能隙玻色子相的连续极限问题，利用代数拓扑和范畴论方法给出了连续极限的严格形式化定义，并构建了一个从晶体拓扑相（覆盖所有有限点群对称性）到连续可逆拓扑相的满射全局映射。研究发现部分晶格相不存在连续极限，而不同的晶格相可能映射到同一连续相（揭示拓扑数据坍缩），同时每个连续可逆相都有忠实的晶体实现。论文还将该框架应用于多个实例，包括二维旋转对称相、高阶拓扑相以及退禁闭量子临界点的混合自旋-晶格反常。
AI.motivation: 连续极限是物理学中广泛使用的理论构造，用于从晶体系统获得连续场论。然而，对于有能隙的玻色子拓扑相，是否能在连续极限下保留其拓扑性质是一个尚未严格回答的基本问题。作者旨在给出连续极限的严格数学定义，并系统性地研究晶格拓扑数据在连续化过程中的保存或丢失。
AI.method: 作者使用代数拓扑和范畴论的方法，为有能隙玻色子相的连续极限提供了严格的形式化框架。他们构建了一个从所有有限点群对称性的晶体拓扑相到连续可逆拓扑相的满射全局映射，通过该映射系统分析晶格拓扑数据在连续化过程中的行为。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) 部分晶格相不存在连续极限；(2) 不同晶格相可以共享同一连续像，表明某些晶格拓扑数据会在连续化过程中坍缩；(3) 每个连续可逆相都承认一个忠实的晶体实现。作者还将框架应用于二维旋转对称相、高阶拓扑相和退禁闭量子临界点的具体实例。
AI.conclusion: 该工作严格建立了晶体拓扑相与连续拓扑相之间的关系，揭示了连续极限并非总能保留晶格拓扑信息。这一框架为理解晶格系统与连续场论之间的拓扑对应关系提供了坚实的数学基础，并为高阶拓扑相和量子临界点等具体物理系统提供了新的分析工具。

title: Thermodynamic Spectroscopy of Emergent Excitations in Quantum Spin Ice
comment: Main text: 7 pages, 3 figures; Supplemental material: 16 pages, 3 figures
summary: Quantum spin ice (QSI) is a three-dimensional quantum spin liquid where fractionalized spinons interact with emergent photons. The XXZ model on the pyrochlore lattice realizes such a $U(1)$ quantum spin liquid and a number of pyrochlore magnets have been investigated as candidate materials, but the detection of emergent excitations has been a major challenge. The specific heat is expected to show the higher-energy spinon excitations and a lower-energy anomaly at the ring-exchange scale, which sets both the photon bandwidth and the energy of the emergent magnetic monopoles (or visons). In reality, the lower-energy peak is obscured by the nuclear Schottky anomaly in non-Kramers Pr-based systems, while it is not clearly resolved from the spinon contributions in Ce-based dipolar-octupolar systems. In this work, we propose a novel thermodynamic probe of the elusive ring-exchange energy scale. We show that in the presence of a weak perturbation coupled to the transverse component of the pseudospin degrees of freedom, the temperature derivative of an observable conjugate to such a weak perturbing force is highly sensitive to the ring-exchange energy scale. Using this scheme, it is shown that the difference between thermal expansion coefficients along the [100] and [010] directions should show a peak at the ring-exchange energy scale for non-Kramers QSI. Similarly, the temperature derivative of the magnetization, $dM/dT$, of dipolar-octupolar pyrochlores under a weak magnetic field can also detect the same signal. Moreover, the sign of these signatures distinguishes the zero-flux and $π$-flux QSI states.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的热力学探测方案，通过测量与弱微扰共轭的物理量对温度的导数，来探测量子自旋冰中被遮挡的环交换能量尺度。具体提出非Kramers体系中[100]和[010]方向热膨胀系数之差，以及偶极-八极烧绿石体系中弱磁场下的dM/dT，均可在环交换能量尺度出现峰值，且其符号能区分零通量和π通量QSI态。
AI.motivation: 量子自旋冰中的涌现激发（自旋子、光子、磁单极子）难以直接探测。环交换能量尺度决定了光子带宽和磁单极子能量，但比热中该低能峰在非Kramers Pr基体系中被核Schottky异常掩盖，在Ce基偶极-八极体系中又与自旋子贡献难以区分，因此亟需新的探测手段。
AI.method: 理论分析表明，对耦合到赝自旋横向分量的弱微扰，其共轭可观测量对温度的导数对环交换能量尺度高度敏感。基于此方案，分别针对非Kramers QSI体系分析热膨胀系数各向异性之差([100]与[010]方向)，针对偶极-八极烧绿石体系分析弱磁场下的dM/dT，两者均能提取环交换能量信号。
AI.result: (1)非Kramers QSI中[100]与[010]方向热膨胀系数之差在环交换能量尺度出现峰值；(2)偶极-八极烧绿石中弱磁场下dM/dT同样能探测该信号；(3)这些信号的符号可以区分零通量和π通量QSI基态。
AI.conclusion: 提出的热力学探针为探测量子自旋冰中被掩盖的环交换能量尺度提供了可行方案，填补了比热测量在该能量范围内的盲区，并能通过信号符号区分不同通量构型的QSI态，为实验验证QSI物理提供了新工具。

title: Light-induced effective magnetic fields in Landau quantized graphene
summary: Ultrafast magnetism triggered by circularly polarized radiation underpins ultrafast spin control, relevant to future technologies, e.g., opto-spintronics and magnonics. The dynamics are often complicated and intertwined among correlated subsystems, such as electrons, spins, phonons, plasmons, topology, and lattice, due to many-body quantum coupling at ultrafast timescales. Here, we demonstrate light-induced effective magnetic fields generated by selective excitation between non-equidistant Landau quantized states in graphene, a prototypical Dirac material, using circularly polarized pulses. By magnetically tuning the Landau-level transition resonance away from other low-energy excitations, we obtain a clean electrostatically controllable platform and identify the microscopic origin of the light-induced magnetic signals, independent of sublattice coupling. Because different Landau levels carry distinct optical Hall conductivities, direct modification of their occupancies via optical excitations creates transient Faraday rotation signals with dispersive magnetic-field dependence, mirroring the static magneto-optical lineshape. The induced effective magnetic field normalized by the pump electric field exceeds typical reported values for the inverse Faraday effect of electronic origin. Our results establish a clear microscopic picture of the inverse Faraday effect of electronic origin, which can trigger hierarchical dynamics among correlated sublattices once Landau-level transitions are magnetically tuned to coincide with other low-energy excitations in Dirac systems and related materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过圆偏振脉冲选择性激发石墨烯中非等距朗道量子态，演示了光诱导的有效磁场（逆法拉第效应），并建立其电子起源的清晰微观图像。通过磁调控朗道能级跃迁共振，获得了静电可控的清洁平台，证实诱导有效磁场强度超过典型电子起源逆法拉第效应的报道值。
AI.motivation: 超快磁性的动力学在超快时间尺度上因多体量子耦合而错综复杂，电子、自旋、声子、等离子体激元、拓扑和晶格等关联子系统相互交织。在石墨烯这类狄拉克材料中，逆法拉第效应的微观机制尚不清晰，亟需建立明确的微观图像以理解光诱导有效磁场的起源。
AI.method: 利用圆偏振脉冲在石墨烯中通过选择性激发非等距朗道量子态来产生光诱导有效磁场。通过磁调控使朗道能级跃迁共振远离其他低能激发，从而获得静电可控的清洁实验平台。不同朗道能级携带不同的光学霍尔电导，通过光学激发直接改变其占据数，产生具有色散磁场依赖性的瞬态法拉第旋转信号。
AI.result: 光诱导的有效磁场（以泵浦电场归一化）超过了典型电子起源逆法拉第效应的报道值。瞬态法拉第旋转信号的色散磁场依赖性镜像了静态磁光线的形状，证实了朗道能级占据数改变是光诱导磁性信号的微观来源，且与亚晶格耦合无关。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了电子起源逆法拉第效应的清晰微观图像，表明一旦朗道能级跃迁在磁调控下与其他低能激发重合，即可触发狄拉克系统及相关材料中关联亚晶格间的层级动力学，为超快自旋操控和光自旋电子学提供了新平台。

title: Spin lifetime anisotropy in graphene induced by the SiO2 interface
summary: Understanding how common dielectric substrates influence the spin transport properties of graphene is essential for advancing graphene-based spintronic technologies. Here we use a comprehensive set of numerical simulations to reveal how a SiO$_2$ substrate modifies the spin texture and governs spin relaxation in graphene. Using first-principles density matrix dynamics simulations, as well as tight-binding (TB) transport simulations, we quantify the effects of electron-phonon scattering, impurity scattering, and electrostatic disorder on the spin relaxation process. We find that a 2D SiO$_2$ substrate induces a predominantly Rashba-type helical spin texture in graphene, leading to a spin lifetime anisotropy of 1/2. Meanwhile, bulk SiO$_2$ breaks in-plane symmetry in graphene, leading to anisotropic in-plane and out-of-plane components in the spin texture, which we capture with a newly-developed TB model of graphene. Transport simulations under realistic disorder conditions reveal a spin lifetime anisotropy between 0.5 and 1, similar to what is seen in measurements of graphene spin valves on a SiO$_2$ substrate. Our results reveal a more complex picture of spin relaxation at the ubiquitous graphene/SiO$_2$ interface, beyond the standard Rashba model, providing critical insight for interpreting experiments and guiding substrate engineering for graphene spintronics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理密度矩阵动力学模拟和紧束缚（TB）输运模拟，系统研究了SiO₂衬底如何改变石墨烯的自旋织构并主导其自旋弛豫过程。研究发现2D SiO₂衬底诱导出以Rashba型为主的螺旋自旋织构，产生1/2的自旋寿命各向异性；而体相SiO₂则打破石墨烯的面内对称性，导致自旋织构的各向异性组分，模拟结果与实验观测相符。
AI.motivation: 理解常见介电衬底如何影响石墨烯的自旋输运性质，对推进基于石墨烯的自旋电子学技术至关重要，因此需要揭示石墨烯/SiO₂界面处更复杂的自旋弛豫机制，超越标准Rashba模型的描述。
AI.method: 采用综合数值模拟方法：1）第一性原理密度矩阵动力学模拟量化电子-声子散射、杂质散射和静电无序对自旋弛豫的影响；2）紧束缚（TB）输运模拟表征不同衬底条件下的自旋织构；3）开发了新的TB模型以捕捉体相SiO₂引起的面内对称性破缺及各向异性自旋组分。
AI.result: 2D SiO₂衬底诱导石墨烯产生以Rashba型为主的螺旋自旋织构，自旋寿命各向异性为1/2；体相SiO₂打破面内对称性产生各向异性的面内和面外自旋组分；在现实无序条件下输运模拟显示自旋寿命各向异性介于0.5到1之间，与实验测量的石墨烯自旋阀结果相符。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了石墨烯/SiO₂界面处自旋弛豫的复杂机制，超越了标准Rashba模型的预测范围，为解释实验现象和指导衬底工程在石墨烯自旋电子学中的应用提供了关键见解。

title: Temperature-Driven Sequential Modeling for the Prediction of Annual Power Conversion Efficiency Profiles of Organic Photovoltaic Materials: Douala Case Study
summary: Organic photovoltaic (OPV) materials are promising candidates for distributed solar energy in tropical regions, yet existing virtual screening tools report static power conversion efficiency (PCE) values at standard testing conditions (STC) that fail to capture the temperature-driven performance degradation experienced under real deployment conditions. Here we introduce a Climate-Native computational framework that forecasts the annual PCE profile of OPV donor molecules under geographically realistic operating conditions. The framework combines GFN2-xTB molecular dynamics with an equivariant graph neural network surrogate ($268$ Neyman-stratified CEP molecules; $120,600$ training geometries; $\sim 1050\times$ speedup over explicit quantum chemistry) and sequential deep learning models trained on annual time series anchored in NASA POWER climate data for Douala, Cameroon, and validated by zero-shot transfer to Yaoundé and Maroua. Applied to $\sim 30,000$ molecules from the Harvard Clean Energy Project (CEP) and validated against $350$ HOPV15 experimental device measurements, the framework demonstrates that sequential models trained on full molecular dynamics trajectories outperform time-averaged baselines ($35\%$-$48\%$ relative MAE improvement over static baselines), confirming that thermal conformational dynamics carry information beyond mean geometry. We further introduce a seasonal stability score that reranks OPV candidates by performance consistency under tropical conditions, identifying molecules whose deployment suitability differs substantially from their static PCE ranking.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个"气候原生"（Climate-Native）计算框架，用于在热带地区真实气候条件下预测有机光伏（OPV）供体分子的年度功率转换效率（PCE）曲线。框架结合GFN2-xTB分子动力学与等变图神经网络代理模型，以及基于NASA POWER气候数据的时序深度学习模型，在~30,000个CEP分子上应用，并用350个HOPV15实验测量值验证，证明全分子动力学轨迹训练的时序模型优于静态基线（MAE相对改善35%-48%），并引入季节性稳定评分来重新排序候选分子。
AI.motivation: 现有OPV虚拟筛选工具只在标准测试条件（STC）下报告静态PCE值，无法捕捉热带地区实际部署条件下温度驱动的性能衰减。热带地区是分布式太阳能的重点应用区域，因此需要一种能预测真实气候条件下性能表现的筛选工具。
AI.method: 框架由三部分组成：(1) GFN2-xTB分子动力学生成构象轨迹；(2) 等变图神经网络代理模型（在268个Neyman分层CEP分子、120,600个训练几何构型上训练，相比显式量子化学加速约1050倍）；(3) 基于NASA POWER气候数据训练的时序深度学习模型，用于预测年度PCE曲线。在喀麦隆杜阿拉进行训练，零样本迁移验证至雅温得和马鲁阿。
AI.result: 对~30,000个CEP分子的筛选结果表明：基于全分子动力学轨迹训练的时序模型相比时间平均基线有35%-48%的相对MAE改进；季节性稳定评分能够重新排序OPV候选分子，识别出与静态PCE排名差异显著的分子；框架在350个HOPV15实验器件上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 热构象动力学携带超越平均几何结构的信息，时序模型能更准确地预测真实气候条件下的性能。提出的季节性稳定评分可作为静态PCE排名的补充指标，帮助筛选在热带条件下性能更稳定的OPV供体分子。

title: Discriminating superconducting fluctuations from the pseudogap in Bi$_2$Sr$_2$Ca$_{n-1}$Cu$_n$O$_{2n+4+δ} (n = 2,3)$: A magnetotransport study
comment: 7 pages 4 figures in the main manuscript; 9 pages 9 figures in the Supplemental Material
summary: Understanding the normal state is essential for uncovering the mechanism of high-$T_c$ superconductivity. We investigate magnetotransport in Bi$_2$Sr$_2$CaCu$_2$O$_{8+δ}$ and Bi$_2$Sr$_2$Ca$_2$Cu$_3$O$_{10+δ}$ single crystals over a wide doping range. While the in-plane resistivity and Hall coefficient show strong pseudogap-induced temperature dependence, the $T^2$ Hall-angle behavior and the modified Kohler's rule remain robust across all dopings. The onset temperatures of the pseudogap are clearly distinct from superconducting fluctuations, although they scale with the pseudogap magnitudes with a factor consistent with a $d$-wave superconductor. These results demonstrate that the pseudogap does not arise from superconducting fluctuations and instead suggest that it may originate from preformed Cooper pairing in the BCS-BEC crossover regime.

AI.tldr: 本文通过研究Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ和Bi₂Sr₂Ca₂Cu₃O₁₀₊δ单晶在不同掺杂范围内的磁输运性质，发现赝隙起始温度与超导涨落明显不同，但与其大小按d波超导体的因子成比例，表明赝隙并非源于超导涨落，而可能源于BCS-BEC交叉区的预形成库珀对。
AI.motivation: 理解正常态的性质是揭示高温超导机制的关键。赝隙是铜氧化物高温超导体的重要特征，但其起源存在争议，需要澄清赝隙是否由超导涨落引起。
AI.method: 在宽掺杂范围内对Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ和Bi₂Sr₂Ca₂Cu₃O₁₀₊δ单晶进行磁输运测量，系统分析面内电阻率、霍尔系数、霍尔角及修正的Kohler规则等行为，并比较赝隙起始温度与超导涨落的关系。
AI.result: 面内电阻率和霍尔系数呈现强烈的赝隙诱导的温度依赖，但T²霍尔角行为和修正的Kohler规则在所有掺杂下保持稳健。赝隙起始温度与超导涨落明显不同，但按与d波超导体一致的因子与赝隙大小成比例。
AI.conclusion: 赝隙并非源于超导涨落，而可能源于BCS-BEC交叉区的预形成库珀配对，为理解高温超导机制提供了重要线索。

title: Second-Derivative-Corrected FANPT for Robust Continuation of Nonlinear Wavefunction Equations
summary: We present a second-derivative-corrected extension of the Flexible Ansatz for N-body Perturbation Theory (FANPT) for solving nonlinear Flexible Ansatz for N-body Configuration Interaction (FANCI) wavefunction equations. The original quasilinear FANPT approximation neglects second- and higher-order derivatives of the determinant overlap with respect to wavefunction parameters. In this work, we retain the overlap Hessian and neglect only third- and higher-order parameter derivatives, thereby including the leading nonlinear response of the wavefunction ansatz while preserving the same response-matrix structure used in the original FANPT formulation. The resulting additional terms enter only through the constant vector of the response equations and are implemented for coupled-cluster wavefunctions in the FanPy/FANCI framework. The new approximation is tested on the Lithium Hydride molecule and the insertion of Beryllium into H$_2$ using seniority-restricted coupled-cluster wavefunctions in the STO-6G basis. The main advantage of the second-derivative correction is that it provides a better initial guess for solving the projected FANCI equations at the next point along the adiabatic connection. This improvement is diagnosed by comparing the FANPT-propagated parameters with the independently optimized FANCI parameters at the same value of $λ$. For nonlinear coupled-cluster ansatzes, especially when larger $λ$-steps are used, the corrected approximation reduces the same-$λ$ parameter deviations and suppresses large parameter-space excursions. These results show that the leading nonlinear overlap correction improves the reliability of FANPT as a continuation strategy for nonlinear wavefunction equations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FANPT的"二阶导数修正"扩展方法，在原有准线性近似的基础上保留重叠Hessian项而舍弃三阶及以上导数，用于求解非线性FANCI波函数方程。该方法仅通过响应方程的常数向量引入额外项，保持了原有响应矩阵结构，并在LiH分子和Be插入H₂两个体系中用seniority限制的耦合簇波函数（STO-6G基组）进行了测试。结果表明，二阶修正提供了更好的初猜，降低了大λ步长下的参数偏差，抑制了参数空间的大幅偏移，提高了FANPT作为非线性波函数方程延拓策略的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 原始的FANPT准线性近似忽略了行列式重叠关于波函数参数的二阶及更高阶导数，这对非线性波函数ansatz（如耦合簇）来说可能造成较大的近似误差，进而影响FANPT作为延拓策略（沿绝热连接推进）的可靠性和初猜质量。
AI.method: 保留重叠Hessian（二阶导数）并只忽略三阶及以上参数导数，从而纳入波函数ansatz的领先阶非线性响应；由于额外项只进入响应方程的常数向量，因此保持了与原FANPT相同的响应矩阵结构。实现上基于FanPy/FANCI框架，对耦合簇波函数进行了测试。
AI.result: 在LiH和Be+H₂两个体系的seniority限制耦合簇波函数（STO-6G基组）测试中，二阶导数修正显著改善了FANPT传播参数与同一λ处独立优化FANCI参数之间的一致性，尤其在大λ步长情形下有效减小参数偏差并抑制参数空间的大幅偏移。
AI.conclusion: 领先阶非线性重叠修正提升了FANPT作为非线性波函数方程连续延拓策略的可靠性和鲁棒性，为后续应用提供了更稳健的初猜生成方案。

title: Large bias-tunable magnetoresistance from spin-dependent interlayer hybridization in van der Waals antiferromagnet CrSBr-based heterostructures
summary: We explore the large magnetoresistance (MR) in \ce{hBN}/few-layer-graphene/\ce{CrSBr}/few-layer-graphene heterostructures and reveal the mechanism behind its non-monotonic bias dependence. Using bias voltage and temperature as independent tuning knobs, we achieve MR up to \SI{350}{\percent} at \SI{20}{K}, characterized by symmetric M-shaped maxima around $\pm 0.5\,\mathrm{V}$. Continuous tuning of the magnetization angle $θ$ via a hard-axis magnetic field shows that the barrier band-edge offset varies linearly with $\cos(θ/2)$, a first-order signature of spin-dependent interlayer hybridization. This linear relationship rules out the Jullière model and a spin-filter projection. We conclude that the magnetic-configuration-dependent band edge, rather than electrode spin polarization, dictates the large magnetoresistance in \ce{CrSBr} junctions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了hBN/少层石墨烯/CrSBr/少层石墨烯异质结中的大磁电阻效应，通过偏压和温度调控实现高达350%的磁电阻，并揭示了其非单调偏压依赖的机制——磁性构型依赖的能带边而非电极自旋极化主导磁电阻。
AI.motivation: 探究CrSBr异质结中巨大磁电阻的物理机制，特别是其非单调偏压依赖背后的起源，并区分Jullière模型与自旋相关层间杂化等不同理论解释。
AI.method: 构建hBN/少层石墨烯/CrSBr/少层石墨烯异质结，以偏压和温度作为独立调控旋钮测量磁电阻，并通过硬轴磁场连续调谐磁化角θ，分析势垒带边偏移与cos(θ/2)的线性关系。
AI.result: 在20K下实现高达350%的磁电阻，呈对称M形特征并在±0.5V处出现极大值；势垒带边偏移与cos(θ/2)呈线性关系，这是自旋相关层间杂化的一阶特征，排除Jullière模型和自旋过滤投影机制。
AI.conclusion: 磁性构型依赖的能带边移动而非电极自旋极化是CrSBr结中巨大磁电阻的决定性机制。

title: Geometry of Noisy Quantum Many-Body Dynamics with Continuous Symmetries: Entanglement and Correlations
summary: We study unitary quantum dynamics in noisy Brownian models with global continuous symmetries, such as $U(1)$ and $SU(2)$, focusing on Rényi entanglement entropies and hydrodynamic and non-hydrodynamic correlators. By mapping the averaged late-time dynamics to the low-energy physics of effective replica Hamiltonians, we find that the evolution is controlled by the quantum geometry of their ground-state manifolds, which is directly related to the geometry of $k$-commutants---the symmetry algebra of $k$ replicas of the system. In interacting systems, these $k$-commutants are generically determined solely by the symmetries of the system, independent of microscopic details of the noisy evolution. This allows us to use the time-dependent variational principle (TDVP) to provide simple geometric explanations for the sub-ballistic Rényi entanglement growth and the anomalous decay of non-hydrodynamic correlators in interacting systems with continuous symmetries. We find this behavior to be intimately connected to singularities within the $k$-commutant manifolds, arising from frozen ``void'' states in the Hilbert space that exist due to continuous on-site symmetries. This also demystifies the important role of voids in the dynamics of these observables, previously identified in $U(1)$ symmetric systems. We compare these behaviors in interacting systems with Abelian and non-Abelian continuous symmetries and in free-fermion systems, which differ in the geometry of their $k$-commutants. Ultimately, this work provides a general geometric framework for systematically studying observables in noisy systems with continuous symmetries, including Haar-random circuits.

AI.tldr: 本文研究具有全局连续对称性（如U(1)和SU(2)）的噪声布朗模型中的酉量子动力学，聚焦于Rényi纠缠熵以及流体力学和非流体力学关联函数。通过将平均后的晚期动力学映射到有效副本哈密顿量的低能物理，发现演化由量子几何（k-commutant流形的几何）控制。利用含时变分原理（TDVP），作者提供了亚弹道Rényi纠缠增长和非流体力学关联函数反常衰减的几何解释，这些行为与k-commutant流形中的奇点（由连续在位对称性导致的"void"态）密切相关。
AI.motivation: 理解具有连续对称性的噪声量子系统中的纠缠动力学和关联函数衰减行为，特别是此前仅在U(1)对称系统中识别的"void"态在动力学中的重要作用，并希望建立一个统一的一般性几何框架来系统研究这些可观测量。
AI.method: 将平均晚期动力学映射到有效副本哈密顿量的低能物理；利用k-commutant（系统的k个副本的对称性代数）的几何结构来描述演化；使用含时变分原理（TDVP）提供几何解释；比较阿贝尔与非阿贝尔连续对称性系统以及自由费米子系统的差异。
AI.result: 在相互作用系统中，k-commutant通常仅由系统的对称性决定，与噪声演化的微观细节无关。亚弹道Rényi纠缠增长和非流体力学关联函数的反常衰减与k-commutant流形中的奇点密切相关，这些奇点源于连续在位对称性导致的希尔伯特空间中的"void"态。阿贝尔与非阿贝尔连续对称性系统以及自由费米子系统在k-commutant几何上存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为研究具有连续对称性的噪声系统（包括Haar随机电路）中的可观测动力学提供了一个通用的几何框架，统一解释了此前分别在U(1)系统中识别的void态作用，并阐明了对称性类型（阿贝尔vs非阿贝尔、相互作用vs自由费米子）对量子几何和动力学行为的影响。

title: Spin nematic liquid crystal and scalar spin chirality in tetragonal lattice YbMnBi$_2$
summary: A spin nematic order, analogous to the nematic liquid crystal, characterizes the spontaneous breaking of spin-space rotational symmetry while preserving time-reversal ($T$) symmetry. In contrast, scalar spin chirality (SSC), a composite three-spin order, breaks $T$ symmetry and is known to induce an anomalous Hall effect (AHE). Although a spin nematic phase has been suggested in frustrated magnets and the square-lattice iridate, how it might affect magnetotransport properties is unknown. Here we use polarized neutron scattering to show that tetragonal $A$MnBi$_2$ ($A$ = Ca, Yb) is a strictly $c$-axis-aligned collinear antiferromagnet (C-type), with $T_N \approx 270$ K and 290 K, respectively. On cooling from 450 K to $T_N$, low-energy spin excitations in YbMnBi$_2$ spontaneously change from isotropic to anisotropic in spin space within the tetragonal plane, forming a dynamic spin nematic phase around 400 K due to heavy Yb-induced spin-orbit coupling, before gapping out below $T_N$. Similar measurements on CaMnBi$_2$ reveal isotropic paramagnetic scattering without a spin nematic phase above $T_N$. Under an in-plane magnetic field, the Yb$^{3+}$ moments may interact with the dynamic spin nematic phase to induce nonzero SSC, giving rise to AHE and an anomalous Nernst effect (ANE) in YbMnBi$_2$ that are absent in CaMnBi$_2$ above $T_N$. A symmetry-based Ginzburg-Landau analysis shows that coupling terms between the nematic order and SSC are allowed under an external magnetic field, which could explain the rapid increase of AHE with field in YbMnBi$_2$. Our results provide compelling evidence for dynamic SSC-induced AHE and ANE in the paramagnetic phase of a compensated collinear antiferromagnet, opening a new avenue for the physics of composite spin orders and room-temperature spintronics without magnetic order.

AI.tldr: 本文通过极化中子散射实验发现，YbMnBi₂在450K至T_N（290K）冷却过程中，其低能自旋激发从各向同性自发转变为自旋空间各向异性，形成动态自旋向列相（约400K），这是由重Yb离子诱导的自旋轨道耦合所致。在外加面内磁场下，Yb³⁺磁矩与动态自旋向列相相互作用可诱导非零标量自旋手性（SSC），从而产生反常霍尔效应（AHE）和反常能斯特效应（ANE），而这些效应在CaMnBi₂中均不存在。基于对称性的Ginzburg-Landau分析表明，外磁场下向列序与SSC之间存在允许的耦合项，解释了AHE随磁场的快速增大。
AI.motivation: 尽管自旋向列相已在阻挫磁体和方晶格铱酸盐中被提出，但其对磁输运性质的影响尚不明确。作者旨在探索动态自旋向列相如何通过与标量自旋手性的耦合，在无磁序的顺磁相中诱导反常霍尔效应和反常能斯特效应，从而将自旋向列物理与拓扑输运现象联系起来。
AI.method: 采用极化中子散射技术研究A MnBi₂（A=Ca, Yb）的自旋激发各向异性；通过低温输运测量探测磁场诱导的AHE和ANE；运用基于对称性的Ginzburg-Landau分析，推导外磁场下向列序与SSC之间的耦合项，阐明微观机制。
AI.result: 1) YbMnBi₂在约400K形成动态自旋向列相（面内自旋空间各向异性），而CaMnBi₂无此现象；2) YbMnBi₂在T_N以上、面内磁场下出现AHE和ANE，CaMnBi₂不出现；3) 向列序与SSC的耦合项在磁场下允许存在，可解释AHE随磁场的快速增加。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次提供了动态SSC诱导AHE和ANE的强有力证据，发生在补偿型共线反铁磁体的顺磁相中，开辟了复合自旋序物理及无磁序室温自旋电子学的新方向。

title: Data-Efficient Adaptation of DPA-4 Force Fields to DFT+U Energetics: A Case Study in NiO
summary: Foundation machine-learned force fields (MLFFs) are often pretrained on broad materials datasets whose electronic-structure conventions may not reproduce the phase energetics required for a specific correlated material. Using NiO as a case study, we examine whether incorrect source-level phase energetics can be corrected efficiently through target-level fine-tuning. Along a common structural interpolation, non-spin-polarized PBE and ferromagnetic PBE+U predict opposite energetic orderings of the octahedral Oct and square-planar Sqr phases. Pretrained DPA-4 models adapt rapidly to the NiO PBE+U surface, reaching energy and force root-mean-square errors (RMSEs) of approximately 0.5 meV/atom and 30 meV/Å, respectively, with approximately 170 PBE+U labels. Crucially, models previously fine-tuned to the opposing no-U surface recover the qualitative PBE+U phase ordering with nearly the same target-data efficiency as models fine-tuned directly from their respective pretrained initializations. Our results show that incorrect source-level phase energetics can be reversed through target-level fine-tuning, and suggest a practical multi-fidelity strategy in which pretraining prioritizes broad, consistent, and affordable data, while compact target-level datasets impose energetics through application-specific fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文以NiO为例，研究了机器学习力场（MLFF）的源级相能量错误能否通过目标级微调有效纠正。结果显示，即使预训练模型在源级具有错误的相能量排序，通过约170个PBE+U标签的目标级微调，模型能快速适应正确的能量面（能量和力RMSE分别约为0.5 meV/atom和30 meV/Å），并能恢复正确的PBE+U相排序。
AI.motivation: 基础机器学习力场通常在广泛材料数据集上预训练，但这些数据集的电子结构约定可能无法复现特定相关材料所需的相能量学。本文探讨是否可以通过目标级微调高效纠正源级错误的相能量学。
AI.method: 以NiO为案例，沿共同的结构插值路径，对比非自旋极化PBE和铁磁PBE+U这两种相反的能量排序。采用DPA-4模型，分别从预训练初始化和已微调到相反（无U）表面的模型进行目标级PBE+U微调，比较两者的数据效率。
AI.result: DPA-4模型仅需约170个PBE+U标签即可达到0.5 meV/atom的能量RMSE和30 meV/Å的力RMSE。关键发现是：先前微调到相反无U表面的模型，恢复正确PBE+U相排序的数据效率与直接从预训练初始化的模型几乎相同。
AI.conclusion: 错误的源级相能量可以通过目标级微调逆转，这支持一种实用的多保真度策略：预训练阶段优先选择广泛、一致且廉价的数据，而通过应用特定的紧凑目标级数据集进行微调来施加正确的能量学。

title: Chemically Meaningful Textualization Enables Explainable Validation of Metal-Organic Frameworks by Large Language Models
summary: Computation-ready metal-organic framework (MOF) databases are essential for high-throughput screening, yet many reported crystal structures remain chemically unreasonable or disordered, compromising simulation fidelity. Existing validation approaches can identify non-computation-ready structures, but they often rely on heuristic rules, license requirement, or offer limited interpretability. Here, we show that large language models (LLMs) can serve as interpretable validators of MOF structures when crystallographic information is transformed into chemically meaningful text. By benchmarking nine descriptors, we find that successful LLM-based validation depends not on the amount of structural information alone, but on whether local coordination, framework connectivity, and chemical context are organized into a linguistically learnable representation. Fine-tuned LLMs using specialized descriptors (mof2text) achieve performance comparable to graph-based models in identifying unreasonable MOFs. Importantly, these models extend beyond black-box classification by generating diagnostic rationales for likely error sources, including abnormal bonding, connectivity, and charge states, as well as error-category predictions for annotated datasets. This work establishes chemically informed textualization as the key step that transforms LLMs from generic text models into practical and explainable tools for curating MOF databases.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了大型语言模型（LLMs）可以作为金属有机框架（MOF）结构的可解释验证器。通过将晶体信息转化为化学上有意义的文本描述（mof2text），微调后的LLM在识别不合理MOF结构方面达到了与基于图的模型相当的性能，并能生成诊断性解释，指出异常键合、连接性和电荷状态等错误来源。
AI.motivation: 现有的MOF数据库中存在大量化学上不合理或无序的晶体结构，影响高通量筛选的仿真保真度。已有的验证方法依赖启发式规则、需要许可证，或解释性有限，因此需要一种既准确又可解释的验证工具。
AI.method: 将MOF的晶体学信息转化为化学上有意义的文本表示，基准测试九种描述符，筛选出能够将局部配位、框架连接性和化学环境组织成可学习语言表示的专门描述符（mof2text）。使用这些描述符对LLM进行微调，用于MOF结构验证和错误类别预测。
AI.result: LLM验证的成功取决于结构信息是否以语言学可学习的方式组织，而非信息量本身。使用mof2text描述符的微调LLM在识别不合理MOF方面与图模型性能相当，并能生成诊断性理由（如异常键合、连接性和电荷状态）以及错误类别预测。
AI.conclusion: 化学信息化的文本化是将LLM从通用文本模型转变为实用且可解释的MOF数据库策展工具的关键步骤，为大规模MOF结构验证提供了可解释的新范式。

title: Light induced superconducting diode effect in patterned films
summary: Structured light offers a route to control superconducting transport without permanently modifying the material or applying a static bias. Here we show that structured optical driving can generate a superconducting diode response in patterned superconducting films with asymmetric holes. Using generalized time-dependent Ginzburg Landau simulations, we find that optical driving produces rectified dc photovoltages and zero bias directional supercurrent imbalance in a junction free geometry, with continuous-drive diode efficiencies of order $10^{-3}$ and pulsed efficiencies reaching $10^{-2}$. The response is controlled by both the hole array and the optical mode. Increasing the number of asymmetric holes enhances rectification, reversing circular helicity reverses the diode polarity, and the optical spatial mode strongly modifies the magnitude and polarity of the directional response. Pulsed excitation enhances the zero bias line cut current imbalance to the percent level. For linearly polarized illumination, the asymmetric metacrystal converts the drive into local chiral supercurrent motion, inducing an inverse Faraday effect like mechanism for dynamical time reversal symmetry breaking. These results establish patterned superconducting films as a viable platform for light-tunable superconducting diode behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了通过结构化光学驱动可以在具有非对称孔的图案化超导薄膜中产生超导二极管响应。利用广义含时Ginzburg-Landau模拟，发现光学驱动在无结几何结构中产生整流直流光电压和零偏置定向超电流不平衡，连续驱动二极管效率约为10⁻³，脉冲驱动效率可达10⁻²。响应由孔阵列和光学模式共同控制，为光可调超导二极管行为提供了可行平台。
AI.motivation: 寻找一种无需永久改变材料或施加静态偏置即可控制超导输运的方法。结构化光提供了一种非侵入式的调控手段，有望实现光可调的超导二极管效应，这一方向此前尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 使用广义含时Ginzburg-Landau模拟方法，研究具有非对称孔的图案化超导薄膜在结构化光学驱动下的响应。系统性地改变孔阵列数量、圆形光偏振手性以及光学空间模式，考察对二极管效率和极性等响应特征的影响。
AI.result: 光学驱动产生整流直流光电压和零偏置定向超电流不平衡；连续驱动二极管效率约10⁻³，脉冲驱动可达10⁻²。增加非对称孔数量增强整流效应，反转圆偏振手性反转二极管极性，光学空间模式显著改变响应幅度和极性。线偏振照射下，非对称超构晶体将驱动转化为局域手性超电流运动，产生类似逆Faraday效应的动态时间反演对称性破缺机制。

title: A Perspective on Phase Space Electronic Structure Theory : From Its Surface Hopping Origins Through To Its Future Promise
summary: We trace the history of phase space electronic structure theory (PSEST), high- lighting how this powerful approach emerged from fundamental questions in semi- classical surface hopping dynamics and evolved into an alternative to standard Born- Oppenheimer based electronic structure theory (with moving instead of frozen nuclei). Our goal herein is not to recapitulate the mathematical details of phase space electronic structure calculations, and few equations are presented so as to maximize readability. Instead, our goal is to provide intuition for those new to the field both (i) regarding the physics present when solving the Schrodinger equation in a non-inertial frame as well as (ii) regarding why PSEST is a necessary step forward towards understanding chemical problems involving spin (with limited practical alternatives). We further high- light some of the many open questions in this fast developing area, which will hopefully inspire new practitioners in this field. This intuitive perspective lacks many equations and is meant to complement (rather than replace) the more technical review given in Bian et al, Chem. Phys. Rev. 7, 011303 (2026)

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了相空间电子结构理论（PSEST）的发展历史，从半经典表面跳跃动力学中的基本问题出发，演变为标准Born-Oppenheimer电子结构理论（运动而非冻结原子核）的替代方案。文章旨在为非专业人士提供关于非惯性参考系中求解薛定谔方程的物理直觉，以及为什么PSEST是理解涉及自旋的化学问题所必需的（实用替代方案有限）。
AI.motivation: 标准Born-Oppenheimer电子结构理论基于"冻结原子核"近似，在处理涉及自旋的化学问题时存在局限性。作者希望通过提供直观的、少公式的视角，帮助新进入该领域的研究者理解PSEST的物理内涵及其必要性，同时激发更多研究者关注这一快速发展的领域。
AI.method: 这是一篇观点/综述性文章，不强调数学细节（尽量少用方程），而是通过历史脉络梳理和物理直觉构建来阐述PSEST：包括（i）在非惯性参考系中求解薛定谔方程所涉及的物理；（ii）为何PSEST是处理自旋相关化学问题的必要前进方向。
AI.result: 文章系统梳理了PSEST从半经典表面跳跃动力学起源到成为独立电子结构理论框架的演变过程，阐述了其相对于传统Born-Oppenheimer方法的物理优势，并指出了该领域中若干未解决的开放问题。
AI.conclusion: PSEST是处理涉及自旋的化学问题的重要可行方案，该领域发展迅速但仍有大量开放问题待探索。本文作为直觉性导览，是对Bian等人（Chem. Phys. Rev. 7, 011303 (2026)）技术性综述的补充而非替代。

title: Layer-Number-Controlled Symmetry Breaking and Surface-State Transport in Rhombohedral Graphene Multilayers
summary: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene hosts layer-polarized flat bands, providing an intriguing platform for correlated and topological electronic states; however, the role of layer number in governing symmetry breaking and surface screening remains elusive. Here we prepare rhombohedral graphene multilayers and systematically conduct electrical transport measurements. We uncover an unconventional layer dependence of phase transitions: the critical displacement field (D$_{c}$) for the layer-antiferromagnetic (LAF)-to-semimetal transitions remains constant across tetralayer to hexalayer graphene, whereas the D$_{c}$ for semimetal-to-layer-polarized-insulator (LPI) transition increases with layer number, defying unscreened Coulomb interaction models. In hexalayer graphene, surface-state-dominated transport emerges, with Landau levels (LLs) and resistive peaks selectively controlled by adjacent gates, a signature of strong interlayer screening absent in thinner stacks. High magnetic fields reveal valley-layer-locked LLs and dissipative states possibly from interlayer backscattering, highlighting the presence of decoupled surface states. Our findings establish layer number as a key tuning knob for engineering correlated and topological phases in rhombohedral graphene multilayers.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了菱面体多层石墨烯中电子相变与层数的依赖关系，发现层反铁磁-半金属转变的临界位移场不随层数变化，而半金属-层极化绝缘体转变的临界位移场随层数增加而增大，并在六层石墨烯中观察到表面态主导的传输现象。
AI.motivation: 菱面体多层石墨烯具有层极化的平带，是研究关联和拓扑电子态的重要平台，但层数如何影响对称性破缺和表面屏蔽效应仍不清楚。
AI.method: 制备菱面体多层石墨烯样品（四层至六层），进行系统的电输运测量，通过调控位移场研究不同层数下的相变行为，并在强磁场下观测朗道能级和电阻峰。

title: Operational identifiability of false-vacuum decay rates in the quantum Ising chain
summary: Extracting a thermodynamic nucleation rate from finite-time quantum dynamics requires separating observable decay from estimator and finite-size validity. We develop a multilevel identification framework to real-time tensor-network simulations of false-vacuum decay in the one-dimensional quantum Ising chain. Across twelve parameter points with non-empty analysis intervals, the same coherent two-kink amplitudes semi-quantitatively predict both infinite-chain survival and magnetization dynamics: the survival coefficient has a median lattice-to-theory ratio of 0.902, while the magnetization-area slope ratios span 0.809--0.953. By contrast, the microscopic nearest-neighbour bond response is coherence dominated: vacuum--pair coherence contributes 60.0--81.5\% within the seven parameter points satisfying the matched-bond-dimension convergence criterion, while substantial late-window slope discrepancies remain that cannot be removed by a scalar normalization. The framework establishes reliable finite-time decay coefficients and identifies the additional finite-size and branch-validation requirements for a bulk thermodynamic rate interpretation. Within the two-kink model, a lattice-resolved WKB action reduces the median fixed-prefactor discrepancy with the coherent-bubble spectral calculation to 4.13\%. Quantitative cross-level consistency, observable-dependent reduced-model error, and a thermodynamic-rate interpretation that remains subject to finite-size validation can therefore coexist.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多层级识别框架，用于从实时张量网络模拟中提取一维量子Ising链假真空衰变的热力学成核速率。通过十二个参数点验证，相干双扭结振幅能半定量预测无限链存活与磁化动力学，但微观键响应由相干性主导，存在无法标量归一化消除的斜率偏差。
AI.motivation: 从有限时间量子动力学中提取热力学成核速率存在困难，需要将可观测衰变与估计器和有限尺寸有效性分离。现有方法缺乏一个能够同时验证不同层级可观测量一致性、识别约化模型误差的系统框架。
AI.method: 开发多层级识别框架，结合实时张量网络模拟一维量子Ising链的假真空衰变。通过相干双扭结振幅同时预测无限链存活动力学与磁化动力学，并对微观最近邻键响应进行相干性分析，结合匹配键维鲁棒性准则与格点分辨WKB作用量进行交叉验证。
AI.result: 存活系数中位格点-理论比为0.902，磁化面积斜率比落在0.809-0.953区间；真空-对相干性贡献占60.0-81.5%（七个满足收敛准则的参数点）；格点分辨WKB作用量将中位固定前因子偏差降至4.13%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架确立了可靠的有限时间衰变系数，揭示了可观测依赖的约化模型误差，并指出体热力学速率解释仍需额外的有限尺寸与分支验证。定量跨层级一致性、可观测依赖误差与有限尺寸验证下的热力学解释可以共存。

title: Phonon anomalies and critical scaling in the spin-$1/2$ trimer chain Na$_2$Cu$_3$Ge$_4$O$_{12}$
comment: Main text: 13 pages, 5 figures Supplemental material 14 pages, 14 figures
summary: Low-dimensional quantum magnets provide an ideal platform to explore spin-lattice coupling-mediated quantum correlations, which give rise to emergent quasiparticle excitations. The antiferromagnetically coupled spin-1/2 trimer chain of copper ions in Na$_2$Cu$_3$Ge$_4$O$_{12}$ (NCGO) hosts high-energy spin excitations of different species, whose energy scales overlap with those of lattice vibrations. Here, we report a comprehensive temperature-dependent Raman spectroscopic study performed between 80 and 400 K. The dynamic spin susceptibility, as obtained from the analysis of the broad spectral background, reveals the emergence of quasiparticle excitations below 170 K. We further identify an unusual crossover of phonon dynamics when the material transits from a normal paramagnetic state to a correlated quantum magnetic state. A power law dependence of the integrated Raman susceptibility of the phonon modes, $I_{χ^{\prime\prime}}^{i}\sim|T-T_{c}|^β$, is observed with the critical temperature $T_c$=167$\pm$1 K, and critical exponent $β= 0.24\pm 0.02$. The combined results obtained from the broad spectral background and sharp phonon peaks further indicate that the phonon renormalization observed across the crossover is driven by dynamic spin states. Additionally, statistical correlations among phonon energy eigenvalues, quantified through matrix-norm and power-test analyses of 200 spectra recorded at 80 K, reveal an unexpected linear correlation among phonon modes, also indicating that the collective lattice response is governed by spin correlations. These findings establish NCGO as a model system for investigating cooperative spin-lattice coupling and critical scaling behavior of phonon dynamics in low-dimensional magnetic materials.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过温度依赖的拉曼光谱研究（80-400 K），揭示了Na₂Cu₃Ge₄O₁₂中准粒子激发在170 K以下的涌现，并发现了从顺磁态到关联量子磁态转变时声子动力学的异常交叉行为，表明声子重整化由动态自旋态驱动。
AI.motivation: 低维量子磁体是探索自旋-晶格耦合介导的量子关联的理想平台，但自旋激发能标与晶格振动能标重叠时，如何区分和量化自旋-声子耦合效应仍然是一个挑战。
AI.method: 对NCGO进行了80至400 K的温度依赖拉曼光谱测量，分析了宽谱背景提取动态自旋磁化率，同时对声子模式进行积分拉曼磁化率的幂律标度分析，并利用矩阵范数和功率检验对80 K下200个光谱的声子能量本征值进行统计相关性分析。
AI.result: 发现准粒子激发在170 K以下涌现；声子动力学在顺磁态到关联量子磁态转变时出现异常交叉，满足Iχ″∼|T-Tc|^β的幂律关系，Tc=167±1 K，β=0.24±0.02；声子模式间发现意外的线性统计相关性，表明集体晶格响应受自旋关联控制。
AI.conclusion: NCGO被确立为研究低维磁性材料中协同自旋-晶格耦合和声子动力学临界标度行为的模型体系。

title: Yttrium Superhydrides Revisited: Advanced Experimental and Theoretical Studies of YH$_6$, YH$_9$ and YH$_{10}$
summary: Yttrium polyhydrides are benchmark materials in high-pressure superconductivity, yet several key properties of the Y-H system remain insufficiently characterized. Here we combine contact transport, contactless radio-frequency measurements, pulsed-field experiments, and first-principles calculations to reinvestigate YH$_6$, YH$_9$, and YH$_{10}$ in the pressure range 140-213 GPa. Yttrium hydrides YH$_6$ ($\textit{$T_c$}$ = 218-221 K) and YH$_9$ ($\textit{$T_c$}$ = 235-237 K) demonstrate narrow superconducting transitions ($\textit{$Δ$T$_c$}$ = 2-5 K), approaching the limit imposed by thermal fluctuations. Pulsed-field measurements on YH$_6$ up to 60 T establish an extended superconducting phase diagram with a linear slope $\textit{dB$_{c2}$/dT}$ = -0.52 T/K, pronounced transition broadening above 30 T, and negligible normal-state magnetoresistance. We report the radio-frequency AC susceptibility study of YH$_6$, providing evidence for superconductivity via high-frequency field screening in a contactless geometry. Experiments involving Pd incorporation, Pd thin-film sputtering, and Al alloying show strong suppression of high-temperature superconductivity, with no transitions detected above 78-120 K. Finally, using density-functional theory with the stochastic self-consistent harmonic approximation, superconducting density-functional theory, and full-bandwidth Migdal-Eliashberg calculations, we show that anharmonic effects substantially reduce the predicted $\textit{$T_c$}$ of cubic YH$_{10}$ to approximately 260-270 K. These results strongly disfavor room-temperature superconductivity in binary yttrium superhydrides.

AI.tldr: 本文通过接触式输运、非接触式射频测量、脉冲场实验和第一性原理计算，重新研究了140-213 GPa压力范围内的YH₆、YH₉和YH₁₀。确认YH₆（Tc=218-221 K）和YH₉（Tc=235-237 K）具有窄的超导转变，建立了YH₆扩展的超导相图，并通过DFT和非谐效应计算表明YH₁₀的实际Tc约为260-270 K，排除了二元钇超氢化物中存在室温超导的可能性。
AI.motivation: 钇多氢化物是高压超导领域的基准材料，但Y-H体系中多个关键性质仍然表征不足，需要更全面的实验和理论验证。
AI.method: 结合接触输运、非接触射频测量、脉冲场实验以及密度泛函理论（含随机自洽谐波近似、超导密度泛函理论和全带宽Migdal-Eliashberg计算）等多种手段，对YH₆、YH₉和YH₁₀在140-213 GPa范围内进行系统研究。
AI.result: YH₆和YH₉展现窄超导转变（ΔTc=2-5 K）；YH₆在60 T脉冲场中建立扩展超导相图（dBc2/dT=-0.52 T/K，30 T以上转变展宽）；射频AC磁化率提供非接触超导证据；Pd掺入、Pd薄膜溅射和Al合金化均强烈抑制高温超导；非谐效应将YH₁₀的预测Tc降至约260-270 K。
AI.conclusion: 二元钇超氢化物中不存在室温超导，此前的室温超导推测需要重新审视。

title: Strain-controlled magnetism and magnetoelasticity in monolayer NiPS$_3$ and CrPS$_4$
summary: We develop a first-principles framework for magnetoelastic coupling in two-dimensional magnets based on a strain-dependent Heisenberg model. In this approach, strain derivatives of the exchange interactions provide direct access to magnetostriction and to the magnetic renormalization of the elastic tensor, establishing a microscopic link between spin interactions and elastic response. We apply the method to monolayer NiPS$_3$ and CrPS$_4$, which exhibit contrasting magnetoelastic behavior. NiPS$_3$ shows weak and nearly isotropic spin-lattice coupling, consistent with a robust zigzag antiferromagnetic ground state. In contrast, CrPS$_4$ displays strong anisotropic coupling, leading to strain-driven transitions between spin-spiral and ferromagnetic phases and significant changes in the critical temperature and elastic response. Our results demonstrate a general route to quantify magnetoelastic effects in low-dimensional magnets and highlight CrPS$_4$ as a promising platform for strain engineering of magnetic order.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于应变依赖Heisenberg模型的第一性原理框架，用于研究二维磁体中的磁弹性耦合。将该方法应用于单层NiPS₃和CrPS₄，发现NiPS₃呈现弱的各向同性自旋-晶格耦合，而CrPS₄展现强各向异性耦合，可通过应变驱动自旋螺旋与铁磁相之间的转变，为低维磁体的应变工程提供了通用路径。
AI.motivation: 二维磁体中的磁弹性耦合对其磁序和弹性响应具有重要影响，但缺乏一种从第一性原理出发的微观框架来量化自旋相互作用与弹性响应之间的联系，因此需要建立系统的方法来研究这一耦合机制。
AI.method: 基于应变依赖的Heisenberg模型构建第一性原理框架，通过交换相互作用的应变导数直接获得磁致伸缩以及弹性张量的磁重正化，从而在微观层面建立自旋相互作用与弹性响应之间的关联。
AI.result: NiPS₃表现出弱且近乎各向同性的自旋-晶格耦合，与其稳健的锯齿形反铁磁基态一致；CrPS₄则显示强各向异性耦合，可导致自旋螺旋相与铁磁相之间的应变驱动转变，并显著改变临界温度和弹性响应。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为量化低维磁体中的磁弹性效应提供了通用途径，并表明CrPS₄是应变工程调控磁序的有前景平台。

title: Relativistic Dirac-Coulomb-Breit Four-Component Multireference Perturbation Theory within the Small Tensor Product Distributed Active Space Framework
summary: We present a four-component multireference second-order perturbation theory (4C-MRPT2) within the small tensor product distributed active space (STP-DAS) framework. The formulation is compatible with the Dirac-Coulomb (DC), Dirac-Coulomb-Gaunt (DCG), and Dirac-Coulomb-Breit (DCB) Hamiltonians, and inherits the memory-efficient and massively parallel STP-DAS algorithm, enabling perturbative treatments over very large external spaces. Benchmark calculations on noble-gas and group-13 atoms demonstrate that 4C-MRPT2 efficiently recovers all-electron dynamic correlation while providing new insight into relativistic correlation effects. The calculations show that the Breit contribution to the correlation energy increases rapidly with atomic number and reaches approximately 4% of the total correlation energy for Xe. The method also shows that second-order correlation energies are only weakly dependent on the choice of multiconfigurational reference orbitals, and that frozen-core and frozen-virtual approximations substantially reduce computational cost with minimal loss of accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个在STP-DAS框架内的四分量多参考二阶微扰理论（4C-MRPT2），适用于DC、DCG和DCB哈密顿量，并通过基准计算证明其能高效恢复全电子动态关联，揭示相对论关联效应。
AI.motivation: 需要处理重原子体系中的相对论效应与电子关联效应，而现有的方法难以在保证效率的同时处理非常大的外空间，因此需要开发兼容不同相对论哈密顿量且内存高效、可大规模并行的多参考微扰方法。
AI.method: 在STP-DAS框架内实现四分量多参考二阶微扰理论，兼容DC、DCG和DCB三种哈密顿量，继承了STP-DAS算法内存高效和大规模并行的优势，可对非常大的外空间进行微扰处理。
AI.result: 对惰性气体和第13族原子的基准计算表明：4C-MRPT2能高效恢复全电子动态关联；Breit项对关联能的贡献随原子序数快速增加，在Xe中约占关联能的4%；二阶关联能对多组态参考轨道选择依赖性很弱；冻结芯和冻结虚轨道近似大幅降低计算成本且精度损失极小。
AI.conclusion: 4C-MRPT2方法不仅有效处理了相对论与电子关联的耦合问题，还提供了对相对论关联效应的新认识，同时证明了方法在实际应用中的高效性和鲁棒性。

title: Dynamics of the spontaneous emission factor in multiple quantum well nanowire lasers
summary: The spontaneous emission factor - often known as the \b{eta} factor - is an important quantity in the description of quantum well lasers, influencing both the threshold power as well as the general shape of the light in-light out (L-L) curve. Past work on modelling multiple quantum well (MQW) nanowire laser devices has typically assumed that the \b{eta} factor is a constant parameter that can either be estimated or fit in a post-hoc manner. However, the \b{eta} factor can be derived from the transitions between valence and conduction bands in semiconductor quantum wells, together with knowledge of the cavity modes. Here we investigate the dynamic nature of the \b{eta} factor for MQW nanowire lasers, and show how it can be computed. We also examine the dependence of the spontaneous emission rate and spontaneous emission factor \b{eta} on the charge carrier density, quantum well thickness, and composition, and discuss the impact on laser threshold and operation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多量子阱（MQW）纳米线激光器中自发辐射因子（β因子）的动态特性，展示了如何从价带与导带间的跃迁以及腔模信息计算β因子，并探讨了其对激光阈值和运行的影响。
AI.motivation: 以往对MQW纳米线激光器的建模通常假设β因子为常数，可事后估计或拟合。然而β因子实际上可由半导体量子阱中价带-导带跃迁及腔模信息推导得出，且其动态特性未被充分研究。
AI.method: 从量子阱中价带与导带之间的跃迁出发，结合腔模知识推导计算β因子；分析自发辐射速率和β因子随载流子密度、量子阱厚度及组分的变化规律。
AI.result: 展示了β因子可被计算而非仅作常数假设，揭示了其对载流子密度、量子阱厚度和组分的依赖关系，并讨论了这些依赖对激光阈值和运行特性的影响。
AI.conclusion: β因子并非恒定参数，而是具有动态特性，其准确计算对于理解和优化MQW纳米线激光器的阈值行为及L-L曲线特性具有重要意义。

title: A piston-like polymer stochastic heat engine
summary: Colloidal stochastic engines are often regarded as microscopic analogues of macroscopic pis ton cylinder heat engines. However, although they share some underlying physical principles, such systems remain far from being direct force generators from a practical perspective. Motivated by this limitation, the present study introduces a polymer-based stochastic engine that more closely mimics the operation of piston cylinder engines. In this setup, heat is converted into work through a cyclic process in which a polymer is pulled into and out of a narrow channel under varying tem peratures. The work performed by the engine can be directly obtained from the cyclic trajectory in the force position diagram, analogous to the pressure volume diagram in traditional heat engines. Despite its much higher number of degrees of freedom compared to colloidal engines, the polymer en gine nevertheless follows several characteristic features observed in such systems. Numerical results demonstrate consistency with universal low-dissipation bounds for e ciency, recovery of Carnot e ciency under regeneration, and low-dissipation scaling of work and power.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于聚合物的随机热引擎，它模仿宏观活塞-气缸热机的工作原理。在循环过程中，聚合物在变温条件下被拉入和拉出狭窄通道，将热量转化为功。该引擎的功可以直接从力-位置图中的循环轨迹获得，类似于传统热机的压力-体积图。数值结果表明，尽管该聚合物引擎比胶体引擎具有更多的自由度，但它仍遵循通用低耗散效率界限、再生条件下恢复卡诺效率以及功和功率的低耗散标度等特征。
AI.motivation: 胶体随机热引擎虽被视为宏观活塞-气缸热机的微观类比，但从实际角度看，它们远不能作为直接的力发生器。这一局限性促使研究者提出一种更接近活塞-气缸引擎工作机制的聚合物随机热引擎。
AI.method: 通过循环过程将聚合物在变温条件下拉入和拉出狭窄通道来实现热-功转换，并从力-位置图（类比p-V图）的循环轨迹直接获取引擎做功，结合数值模拟研究其效率与功率特性。
AI.result: 数值结果表明该聚合物引擎满足通用低耗散效率界限，在再生条件下恢复卡诺效率，且功和功率遵循低耗散标度关系。
AI.conclusion: 尽管聚合物系统自由度远高于胶体引擎，该聚合物随机引擎仍保持了随机热机的核心特征，为构建更实用、更接近宏观活塞引擎的微观热机提供了可行途径。

title: Two routes to quantum anomalous Hall states in altermagnets
summary: We theoretically propose two possible routes to realizing quantum anomalous Hall states in altermagnetic materials. We consider a minimal square-lattice Hubbard model with antisymmetric spin-orbit coupling associated with an orthorhombic crystal structure, which supports a topologically trivial altermagnetic state. By incorporating Rashba-type spin-orbit coupling and external perturbations, we demonstrate that this trivial state can be turned into topological altermagnetic phases in two distinct ways. The first route is driven by a staggered potential that breaks the symmetry connecting crystallographically equivalent sublattices, leading to a topological altermagnetic ground state characterized by a quantized Hall conductivity $\left| σ_{xy} \right|=e^2/h$ and a Chern number $C=1$. The second route is realized by applying a magnetic field perpendicular to the two-dimensional plane. The resulting topological state appears as a metastable state in the magnetic hysteresis loop, exhibiting a quantized Hall conductivity $\left| σ_{xy} \right|=2e^2/h$ associated with a Chern number $C=2$. We show that these topological transitions are accompanied by characteristic gap closings at the Brillouin-zone boundary, with the number of gap-closing points determining the Chern number. Ribbon-geometry calculations reveal chiral edge states consistent with the bulk topological invariants and demonstrate distinct spin polarizations between the $C=1$ and $C=2$ states. Our results establish experimentally accessible routes to quantized anomalous Hall responses in altermagnets.

AI.tldr: 本文理论上提出了在交变磁材料中实现量子反常霍尔态的两种途径。通过构建具有反对称自旋轨道耦合的正交晶格哈伯德模型，结合Rashba自旋轨道耦合和外部扰动，分别通过层错势和垂直磁场实现Chern数为1和2的拓扑交变磁相，并展示了量子化的霍尔电导。
AI.motivation: 交变磁材料作为一种新型磁性材料，兼具反铁磁和铁磁特性，但如何在其基态中实现拓扑量子反常霍尔效应尚未被充分探索。本文旨在填补这一空白，提出可行的实验路径。
AI.method: 采用最小方格晶格哈伯德模型，包含正交晶体结构对应的反对称自旋轨道耦合。通过引入Rashba自旋轨道耦合，并分别施加（1）打破亚晶格对称性的层错势和（2）垂直磁场，实现两种不同的拓扑相变。利用能带拓扑不变量（Chern数）、霍尔电导率计算及带状几何（ribbon）边界态分析验证拓扑性质。
AI.result: 第一种途径：层错势驱动得到Chern数C=1、霍尔电导|σxy|=e²/h的拓扑交变磁基态。第二种途径：垂直磁场得到Chern数C=2、霍尔电导|σxy|=2e²/h的亚稳态。两种拓扑转变伴随布里渊区边界处特征性的能隙闭合，闭合点数决定Chern数。带状计算显示与体拓扑不变量一致的手征边界态，且C=1和C=2态具有不同的自旋极化特征。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为在交变磁材料中实现量子反常霍尔效应提供了两条实验可行的途径，并确立了可量化的反常霍尔响应信号，为后续实验探索提供了明确的理论指导。

title: Acoustic Plasmon Resonance: Breaking the Anderson Stiffness Paradigm in Quasi-Two-Dimensional Superconducting Films
summary: Recent experiments on superconducting films have revealed an acoustic plasmon mode that depends critically on the superconducting transition, directly challenging the long-standing Anderson-Higgs paradigm regarding the stiffness of the plasma spectrum in superconductors. In this Letter, we provide a microscopic theoretical framework that explains this behavior and establishes the physical conditions under which classical Anderson-Higgs constraints are bypassed. We demonstrate that in films of finite thickness, the transverse redistribution of normal and superfluid charge densities enables a unique coupling mechanism to electromagnetic radiation - a feature fundamentally absent in the conventional Carlson-Goldman scenario. Our theory predicts an acoustic mode whose dispersion, temperature scaling, and dependence on film thickness are in remarkable agreement with recent experimental observations. By delineating the regime of this acoustic response, we reconcile the observed electromagnetic activity of collective excitations with the fundamental principles of superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个微观理论框架，解释了超导薄膜中观测到的声学等离激元模式，并阐明了在何种物理条件下可以绕过经典的Anderson-Higgs约束。理论预测的色散关系、温度标度和膜厚依赖性均与近期实验观察高度一致。
AI.motivation: 近期超导薄膜实验发现了依赖超导转变的声学等离激元模式，这直接挑战了长期公认的Anderson-Higgs范式（即超导体中等离子体谱是"刚性"的）。作者旨在从微观层面解释这一现象，并明确经典约束被绕过的物理条件。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个针对有限厚度超导薄膜的微观理论框架，揭示了横向法向/超流电荷密度的重新分布能够产生一种与电磁辐射耦合的独特机制，这一机制在传统的Carlson-Goldman方案中是不存在的。
AI.result: 理论预测的声学模式在色散关系、温度标度以及膜厚依赖性方面均与近期实验结果显著吻合，从而调和了集体激发的电磁活性与超导基本原理之间的矛盾。
AI.conclusion: 该工作明确了声学等离激元响应的存在区域，证明了在一定条件下超导体中可以存在对电磁辐射活跃的声学集体模式，从而拓展了对超导体中等离激元物理的理解，并修正了Anderson-Higgs范式的适用范围。

title: Many-Body Destabilization of Intermediate Oxygen-Hole States
summary: Oxygen holes in transition-metal oxides can appear as localized polarons, symmetry-delocalized ligand holes, or intermediate states whose stability is controlled by subtle electron-correlation effects. In layered Na$_{2-x}$Mn$_3$O$_7$, hybrid density functional theory (DFT) predicts an unusual bond-centered split oxygen-hole polaron stabilized near ordered Mn vacancies. Here we resolve the nature of this state using diffusion Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC). Although hybrid DFT favors the split configuration, QMC reverses the energetic ordering and identifies the localized oxygen polaron as the lower-energy state. The result is robust to the class of trial wavefunctions used, including hybrid and generalized-gradient DFT wavefunctions. Many-body spin densities further show that the nominal split state partially collapses toward a localized polaron. Because localized and split configurations produce similar O K-edge spectral features, this qualitative failure is not resolved by conventional X-ray absorption signatures alone. These findings identify Na$_{2-x}$Mn$_3$O$_7$ as a stringent benchmark for oxygen-hole polarons and reveal a failure mode of hybrid functionals in correlated oxides.

AI.tldr: 本文使用扩散量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）方法研究了层状Na₂₋ₓMn₃O₇中氧空穴极化子的本质。混合密度泛函理论（DFT）预测了一种不寻常的键中心分裂氧空穴极化子，但QMC反转了这一能量排序，确定局域化氧极化子为更低能量状态，揭示了混合泛函在相关氧化物中的失败模式。
AI.motivation: 过渡金属氧化物中的氧空穴可以呈现局域极化子、对称离域配体空穴或中间态等多种形式，其稳定性由微妙的电子关联效应控制。混合DFT预测在Na₂₋ₓMn₃O₇中Mn空位附近存在键中心分裂氧空穴极化子，但这一预测需要更精确的方法验证，以判断混合泛函在此类相关氧化物中的可靠性。
AI.method: 使用扩散量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）方法，结合多种试探波函数（包括混合泛函和广义梯度近似DFT波函数），计算不同氧空穴极化子构型的能量排序，并通过多体自旋密度分析极化子态的空间分布特征。
AI.result: QMC反转了混合DFT的能量排序，确定局域化氧极化子为更低能量态，该结果对试探波函数类型（混合或GGA DFT波函数）均稳健。多体自旋密度显示名义上的分裂态会部分塌缩为局域极化子。此外，局域化和分裂构型产生相似的O K-edge光谱特征，传统X射线吸收无法区分。
AI.conclusion: Na₂₋ₓMn₃O₇为氧空穴极化子研究提供了严格的基准体系，其结果表明混合泛函在相关氧化物中预测氧空穴极化子构型时存在定性失败，凸显了高精度多体方法（如QMC）在验证DFT预测中的必要性。

title: Simulating Ionic Liquid Fragmentation in Electrospray Thrusters with Foundation Models
summary: Predicting the products of ionic-liquid impacts on extractor surfaces is important for electrospray-thruster lifetime analysis, yet available atomistic methods require a compromise between chemical fidelity and computational cost. Reactive force fields enable high-throughput sampling but do not explicitly resolve electronic charge redistribution and may miss relevant reaction pathways during impact, whereas mixed quantum--classical density-functional-theory molecular dynamics (DFT/MD) can capture charge redistribution and neutral-product formation at substantially higher computational cost. Pretrained atomistic foundation models have recently emerged as a potential route toward DFT-like chemical fidelity at considerably lower cost. Here, we benchmark two pretrained machine-learning interatomic potentials, MACE-MP-0 (medium) and MACE-POLAR-1, against DFT/MD and ReaxFF for geometry optimization of 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium tetrafluoroborate (EMI-BF$_4$) and for 10-100 eV impacts on a model Au extractor surface. The models reproduce several collision outcomes observed in DFT/MD, including ionic dissociation, high-energy covalent fragmentation, and, in particular, HF formation through neutralization-like chemistry that is not captured in the ReaxFF simulations. In the computational-performance benchmark, MACE-POLAR-1 and MACE-MP-0 (medium) completed each 2~ps trajectory in 5.12 and 2.54~min, respectively, corresponding to wall times approximately four orders of magnitude shorter than the DFT/MD reference under the reported benchmark conditions. These results support pretrained machine-learning potentials as a practical intermediate-cost approach for chemically resolved electrospray-impact simulations and motivate targeted fine-tuning with DFT data for broader applications in electrospray-thruster and electric-propulsion modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文基准测试了两个预训练的机器学习原子间势（MACE-MP-0和MACE-POLAR-1），用于预测离子液体在萃取器表面撞击的产物。与DFT/MD相比，这些模型能以约四个数量级更低的计算成本捕获关键化学反应（包括HF形成），同时优于无法捕获中和反应的ReaxFF，为电喷雾推进器寿命分析提供了实用的中等成本方案。
AI.motivation: 电喷雾推进器寿命分析需要预测离子液体撞击萃取器表面的产物，但现有原子级方法存在化学保真度与计算成本之间的权衡：ReaxFF高通量但无法解析电子电荷重分布和反应途径，DFT/MD虽能捕获电荷重分布和中性产物形成但计算成本极高。需要一种兼具化学保真度和计算效率的替代方案。
AI.method: 对两个预训练机器学习原子间势（MACE-MP-0 medium版本和MACE-POLAR-1）进行基准测试，将其与DFT/MD和ReaxFF对比，用于1-乙基-3-甲基咪唑四氟硼酸盐（EMI-BF₄）的几何优化以及10-100 eV能量下在模型Au萃取器表面的撞击模拟，评估其化学产物预测能力和计算性能。
AI.result: 两个机器学习势模型成功重现了DFT/MD中观察到的多种碰撞结果，包括离子解离、高能共价碎裂，特别是ReaxFF无法捕获的HF形成（通过类中和化学反应）。计算性能方面，MACE-POLAR-1和MACE-MP-0（medium）完成每个2 ps轨迹分别仅需5.12分钟和2.54分钟，比DFT/MD参考快约四个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 预训练机器学习势可作为电喷雾撞击模拟中实用且化学可分辨的中等成本方法，并建议使用DFT数据对这些模型进行针对性微调，以扩展到电喷雾推进器和电推进建模的更广泛应用场景。

title: Spatially Resolving the Pre-Thermal Anatomy of a Driven Bosonic Fluid
summary: Understanding how coherently driven quantum many-body systems redistribute energy prior to thermal equilibrium remains a central challenge in many-body physics. Here, we utilize nitrogen-vacancy (NV) magnetometry to perform micron-scale spatial imaging of room-temperature magnon dynamics in a yttrium iron garnet (YIG) thin film. We resolve a hierarchy of discrete parametric scattering events that serve as deterministic stepping stones toward thermalization. By applying a two-tone wave-mixing protocol, we first isolate the elementary four-magnon interaction and extract its coupling strength via the spatial growth of the scattering product. We then drive the system with an intense single-frequency excitation near ferromagnetic resonance, revealing that magnon-magnon interactions trigger a spontaneous, multi-generation scattering cascade. We demonstrate that in each generation, the dominant scattering channels correspond to one of the out-scattered magnons being in the slow magnon regime, reminiscent of the enhancement of optical nonlinearities in slow light systems. We capture this dynamics quantitatively using a near field magnonics framework and extract the cascade order and nonlinear coefficients directly from power-dependent frequency shifts. By revealing the multi-stage dynamical process through which monochromatic injected magnons evolve toward equilibrium, our work establishes spatially resolved magnonics as a powerful platform for visualizing non-equilibrium many-body kinetics.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用氮空位(NV)磁强计对钇铁石榴石(YIG)薄膜中的室温磁振子动力学进行微米级空间成像，解析了从四磁振子散射到多代级联散射的热化路径，建立了空间分辨磁振子学作为可视化非平衡多体动力学的强大平台。
AI.motivation: 理解相干驱动的量子多体系统在达到热平衡前如何重新分配能量是多体物理学的核心挑战。目前缺乏在空间尺度上直接可视化磁振子散射级联动力学的手段，需要一种能够揭示磁振子系统非平衡热化路径的实验方法。
AI.method: 1) 利用NV磁强计对YIG薄膜进行微米级空间成像；2) 采用双音波混频协议隔离基本四磁振子相互作用，通过散射产物的空间增长提取耦合强度；3) 使用单频强激发驱动系统，观察自发多代散射级联；4) 建立近场磁振子学框架，从功率依赖的频率位移中提取级联阶数和非线性系数。
AI.result: 揭示了离散参数散射事件构成的确定性热化阶梯；证明每代级联中主导散射通道对应一个出射磁振子处于慢磁振子区（类似于慢光系统中光学非线性增强效应）；定量捕获了多代散射级联动力学并提取了非线性系数。
AI.conclusion: 通过揭示单色注入磁振子向平衡态演化的多阶段动力学过程，确立了空间分辨磁振子学作为可视化非平衡多体动力学的强有力平台。

title: Ideal heat engine cycles at maximal efficiency -- the ideal gas and beyond
summary: Given a particular heat engine cycle, what is the optimal working medium that results in the highest efficiency? While one might jump to the conclusion that it must surely be the ideal gas, the situation is actually more intricate. Starting with a general Hemlholtz potential that depends polynomially on molar volume and temperature we derive exact expressions for the ideal Stirling, Otto, and Brayton cycles. We find that quite universally the maximal efficiency is achieved for thermodynamics systems, whose working mediums are linear in temperature. This includes the ideal gas, but also classical harmonic oscillators and pheonmenological models of the rubber band.

AI.tldr: 本文研究热机循环中工作介质的最优选择问题，发现效率最高的工作介质并非一定是理想气体，而是其热力学性质在温度上呈线性关系的系统，包括理想气体、经典谐振子以及橡胶带的唯象模型。
AI.motivation: 传统直觉认为理想气体是热机的最佳工作介质，但作者指出实际情况更为复杂。本文旨在系统地回答：对于给定的热机循环，什么工作介质能实现最高效率？
AI.method: 从一般性的亥姆霍兹势出发，假设其关于摩尔体积和温度呈多项式依赖关系，推导出斯特林循环、奥托循环和布雷顿循环的精确效率表达式，并通过分析这些表达式来确定最优工作介质的形式。
AI.result: 研究发现，最高效率普遍由工作介质在温度上呈线性关系的热力学系统实现，这包括理想气体、经典谐振子以及橡胶带的唯象模型等。
AI.conclusion: 理想气体并非唯一甚至并非必然的最佳工作介质；只要系统的热力学性质随温度线性变化，就能在给定的热机循环中达到最大效率，这扩展了对最优热机工作介质的理解。

title: Connecting the tensor-categorical formulation of anyon condensation with operator algebras and entropic order parameters
summary: Anyon condensation that describes the transition between topological quantum field theories can be formulated in the language of tensor categories or that of operator algebras. We deploy the formalism of Doplicher-Haag-Roberts bimodules over quasi-local $\mathrm{C}^{*}$-algebras recently developed in [1] to investigate anyon condensation, which is associated with an extension of a certain operator algebra. The connection between notions in the two formulations is thereby made manifest in an intuitive, diagrammatic manner. An entropic order parameter, as the quantum information-theoretic measure characterising a condensation, is naturally defined, and we give a very simple proof of a bound on it.

AI.tldr: 本文利用最近发展的基于准局部C*-代数的Doplicher-Haag-Roberts双模形式主义来研究任意子凝聚（拓扑量子场论之间的转变），通过算子代数扩张的视角，以直观的图解方式建立了张量范畴与算子代数两种表述之间的联系，并自然地定义了熵序参量作为凝聚的量子信息论度量，给出了其上界的简洁证明。
AI.motivation: 任意子凝聚描述了拓扑量子场论之间的相变，已有张量范畴和算子代数两种形式化语言。作者希望弥合这两种表述之间的鸿沟，利用近期发展的DHR双模框架（基于准局部C*-代数），使两种形式主义中的概念联系变得更加直观和清晰。
AI.method: 采用Doplicher-Haag-Roberts双模（over quasi-local C*-algebras）的形式主义，将任意子凝聚与算子代数的扩张相联系；通过图解化的方法直观展示张量范畴与算子代数两个表述中概念之间的对应关系；定义熵序参量作为表征凝聚的量子信息论度量，并对其上界给出简洁证明。
AI.result: 成功建立了两种形式主义（张量范畴与算子代数）之间概念联系的直观图解化表述；自然地定义了熵序参量作为凝聚的量子信息论量度；给出了该序参量上界的一个非常简单的证明。

title: Thickness-Driven Superconductor-Insulator Transition in (Cu,C)-1234 and Proximity-Induced Superconductivity Recovery in (Cu,C)-1234/YBCO Heterostructure
summary: Superconducting proximity effect and related thickness-driven property evolution remain an important issue in understanding high temperature superconductors. Among proximity systems, superconductor-superconductor (S-S') is special for the existence of intrinsic superconductivity in both materials. Such platform allows the different superconducting orders to compete, couple and reconstruct at the interface. In this paper, (Cu,C)-1234/YBCO heterostructure grown on LAO (001) with fixed thickness of bottom YBCO layer as 150 nm and varied thickness of top (Cu,C)-1234 layer as 188nm, 87 nm, 18nm and estimated 1.2 nm were fabricated and component films were preserved. Electrical transport characterization indicated that as the thickness decrease the (Cu,C)-1234 film degrades and underwent the superconductor-insulator transition (SIT) from thicker to less than 18 nm. In contrast, superconductivity is re-established in transport measurements when the insulating (Cu,C)-1234 layer is coupled to superconducting YBCO As the (Cu,C)-1234 thickness is further reduced to approximately 1.2 nm, the recovered superconductivity is strongly suppressed. The observed thickness dependence is consistent with a scenario in which interfacial coupling restores superconductivity over a finite thickness range before increasing disorder and dimensional confinement dominate in the two-dimensional limit. This work establishes a promising platform for investigating interfacial coupling between cuprate superconductors and provides new insight into the superconducting proximity effect in high-temperature superconducting heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文制备了(Cu,C)-1234/YBCO超导-超导异质结，研究厚度变化下的超导邻近效应。发现(Cu,C)-1234层随厚度减薄发生超导-绝缘体转变，但与超导YBCO耦合后可在有限厚度范围内恢复超导电性，而在二维极限下超导被强烈抑制。
AI.motivation: 超导邻近效应及相关厚度驱动的性质演化是理解高温超导体的重要问题。其中超导-超导(S-S')体系因两种材料均具有本征超导电性，允许不同超导序在界面竞争、耦合和重构，值得深入研究。
AI.method: 在LAO(001)衬底上生长固定厚度150 nm YBCO底层和不同厚度(188、87、18及约1.2 nm)的(Cu,C)-1234顶层异质结，并保留组分薄膜作对照，通过电输运表征研究其性质。
AI.result: 随厚度减小，(Cu,C)-1234薄膜退化并在小于18 nm时经历超导-绝缘体转变(SIT)；但与超导YBCO耦合后，绝缘性的(Cu,C)-1234层中超导被重新恢复；当厚度进一步减至约1.2 nm时，恢复的超导被强烈抑制。厚度依赖符合界面耦合在有限厚度范围内恢复超导、随后无序和维度限制主导二维极限的图景。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了研究铜氧化物超导体间界面耦合的有前景平台，为高温超导异质结中的超导邻近效应提供了新见解。

title: Symmetry-Dependent Mechanical and Vibrational Response of Formamidinium Lead Halide Perovskites: A DFT Study
summary: Formamidinium-based hybrid halide perovskites (FAPbX3, X = Cl, Br, and I) have attracted considerable attention for optoelectronic applications owing to their outstanding optical and electronic properties. However, the influence of crystal symmetry reduction on their mechanical behavior and stability has not yet been comprehensively understood. In this work, density functional theory (DFT) calculations were performed to investigate the structural, elastic, dynamical, and nonlinear mechanical properties of the cubic and ps-cubic phases of FAPbX3. The elastic constants, bulk, shear, and Young's moduli, Poisson's ratio, sound velocities, and Debye temperature were evaluated and correlated with the second Piola-Kirchhoff stress-strain response under tensile and compressive loading. The results reveal that the effect of symmetry reduction is strongly dependent on the halide composition. For FAPbCl3 and FAPbBr3, the transition from the cubic to the ps-cubic phase reduces the lattice stiffness, decreases the acoustic phonon velocities, and lowers the Debye temperature, whereas the opposite trend is observed for FAPbI3. The stress-strain analysis further reveals pronounced nonlinear, anisotropic, and asymmetric mechanical behavior, demonstrating that symmetry reduction can either activate or suppress strain-accommodation mechanisms depending on the halide species, thereby governing the mechanical stability and the onset of structural softening. These findings provide microscopic insight into the relationship between crystal symmetry, lattice dynamics, and nonlinear mechanical response in formamidinium-based halide perovskites, offering useful guidance for the design of mechanically robust optoelectronic materials.

AI.tldr: 本文利用密度泛函理论(DFT)系统研究了甲脒基杂化卤化物钙钛矿(FAPbX3, X=Cl/Br/I)立方相和伪立方相的力学行为，揭示了晶体对称性降低对弹性、动力学及非线性力学性能的影响强烈依赖卤素组分，为设计力学稳健的光电材料提供了微观指导。
AI.motivation: FAPbX3钙钛矿在光电领域具有重要应用前景，但晶体对称性降低（立方相到伪立方相）对其力学行为和稳定性的影响尚未被全面理解，这限制了材料的实际应用与优化设计。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论(DFT)计算，研究了FAPbX3立方相和伪立方相的结构、弹性、动力学及非线性力学性质。计算了弹性常数、体模量、剪切模量、杨氏模量、泊松比、声速和德拜温度，并将其与拉伸和压缩加载下的第二Piola-Kirchhoff应力-应变响应相关联。
AI.result: 对称性降低对力学性能的影响强烈依赖卤素组分：FAPbCl3和FAPbBr3从立方相转变到伪立方相后晶格刚度降低、声学声子速度减小、德拜温度下降；而FAPbI3呈现相反趋势。应力-应变分析揭示了显著的非线性、各向异性和不对称力学行为，表明对称性降低可依据卤素种类激活或抑制应变容纳机制，从而决定力学稳定性和结构软化的起始。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了晶体对称性、晶格动力学与非线性力学响应之间的微观联系，为设计力学性能稳健的钙钛矿光电材料提供了有价值的理论指导。

title: Realization of Arbitrary Gauge Fields via Symmetry-Protected Zero Modes
summary: Gauge fields are fundamental to modern physics, but prescribed gauge configurations are often difficult to implement in artificial systems. Here, we present a general scheme for realizing arbitrary static $\mathrm{O}(N)$ lattice gauge configurations using symmetry-protected zero modes of sublattice-imbalanced bipartite units. The target $\mathrm{O}(N)$ link on each bond is encoded in the connectivity and strengths of positive microscopic couplings. By decoupling the zero-mode manifold from the remaining modes, the target gauge Hamiltonian forms an exact spectral block of the microscopic tight-binding model rather than a perturbative approximation. We experimentally demonstrate this framework in acoustic crystals through a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ quadrupole topological insulator, an $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ Hofstadter model, and an $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ non-Abelian topological insulator. Our results provide a general and accessible route to gauge-field physics in artificial systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用子晶格不平衡二部单元的对称保护零模来精确实现任意静态O(N)晶格规范场的通用方案。通过将目标规范场编码在微观正耦合的连通性和强度中，零模流形与其余模式解耦，使目标规范哈密顿量成为微观紧束缚模型的精确谱块而非微扰近似。作者在声学晶体中实验展示了Z2四极拓扑绝缘体、SO(2)Hofstadter模型和SO(3)非阿贝尔拓扑绝缘体。
AI.motivation: 规范场对现代物理学至关重要，但在人工系统中实现特定的规范构型往往很困难。现有的实现方法通常依赖微扰近似，缺乏精确性，因此需要一种通用、精确且易实现的方案来构建任意静态O(N)晶格规范场。
AI.method: 利用子晶格不平衡二部单元的对称保护零模，将目标O(N)链接编码在每个键上的微观正耦合的连通性和强度中。通过解耦零模流形与其余模式，使得目标规范哈密顿量作为微观紧束缚模型的精确谱块出现，而非近似结果。实验上在声学晶体中实现了三种不同的规范场系统。
AI.result: 实验成功实现了三类规范场系统：Z2四极拓扑绝缘体、SO(2)Hofstadter模型和SO(3)非阿贝尔拓扑绝缘体，验证了该框架的通用性和精确性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一条通向人工系统中规范场物理的通用且易实现的途径，能够精确而非近似地实现任意静态O(N)晶格规范构型。

title: Macroscopic fluctuation theory for the multi-time statistics of current in non-stationary diffusive systems
comment: 50 pages, 5 figures, JSTAT Special Issue StatPhys29
summary: The statistics of current fluctuations has long been a central object of study in non-equilibrium physics. Most existing work has focused on one-time statistics, while their multi-time generalisation remains comparatively less explored. We address this gap by extending the fluctuating hydrodynamics framework of Macroscopic Fluctuation Theory (MFT) to study multi-time statistics in the non-stationary state of a diffusive system on an infinite line. For the simplest cases of a non-interacting lattice gas and hard-core Brownian point particles, we present explicit solution of the MFT leading to multi-time large-deviation statistics. For generic systems, the MFT is solved perturbatively, yielding explicit results for two-time correlations. These reveal that the connection between current fluctuations and fractional Brownian motion, previously observed for flat initial conditions, does not persist for step initial conditions. We independently verify these hydrodynamic results by solving the corresponding microscopic dynamics for the non-interacting gas and for the symmetric simple exclusion process. Additional confirmation comes from numerical simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了宏观涨落理论（MFT）框架，用于研究一维扩散系统在非稳态下的多时间电流统计。对于非相互作用晶格气体和硬核布朗点粒子，给出了多时间大偏差统计的显式解；对于一般系统，通过微扰方法求解MFT，得到双时间关联的显式结果，并通过微观动力学求解和数值模拟加以验证。
AI.motivation: 电流涨落的统计量是研究非平衡物理的核心对象，但大多数已有工作聚焦于单时间统计，多时间推广研究较少。作者旨在填补这一空白，扩展MFT框架来研究非稳态扩散系统中的多时间电流统计。
AI.method: 将MFT的涨落流体动力学框架扩展到多时间统计场景。对最简单的系统（非相互作用晶格气体、硬核布朗点粒子）给出MFT的显式解；对一般系统采用微扰方法求解，得到双时间关联的显式表达式，并与微观动力学（如非相互作用气体和对称简单排斥过程）的解析解及数值模拟结果进行交叉验证。
AI.result: 发现电流涨落与分数布朗运动之间的联系在平坦初始条件下成立，但在阶跃初始条件下不成立。双时间关联结果通过微观动力学精确解和数值模拟得到独立验证。
AI.conclusion: 扩展的MFT框架能够有效处理多时间电流统计问题，为理解非平衡系统中多时间涨落的普适行为提供了新的理论工具，并揭示了初始条件对电流涨落普适性的重要影响。

title: Proliferation Transitions for Non-Abelian Anyons
summary: We construct phase transitions that proliferate condensable anyons in general 2+1d topological orders, including non-abelian ones. The central tool that provides a systematic approach to this question is the Symmetry Topological Field Theory (SymTFT). For a given topological order, we identify the relevant symmetry from the transparent lines generated by the condensable anyons, and thereby realize the topological order in terms of a 3+1d SymTFT sandwich. The proliferation phase transition is realized by coupling scalar fields to the anyons purely on the symmetry boundary of the SymTFT. We illustrate the construction for abelian theories, as well as non-abelian ones, $D(S_3)$ and $SU(2)_k$ Chern-Simons theories, and extend it to anomalous anyons.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了二维拓扑序中凝聚任意子的相变，利用对称性拓扑场论（SymTFT）作为系统工具，将拓扑序嵌入3+1维SymTFT三明治结构中，通过标量场与对称边界上的任意子耦合实现凝聚相变，并扩展到非阿贝尔理论和异常任意子情形。
AI.motivation: 在一般的2+1维拓扑序（包括非阿贝尔情形）中，凝聚可凝聚任意子所触发的相变缺乏系统性构造方法。作者希望建立一种统一框架，能够系统地处理和构造这类相变。
AI.method: 利用SymTFT作为核心工具：首先从可凝聚任意子生成的透明线中识别相关对称性，将拓扑序表示为3+1维SymTFT三明治结构；然后在对称边界上通过将标量场耦合到任意子来实现凝聚相变。
AI.result: 构造方法适用于阿贝尔理论、非阿贝尔理论（D(S₃)和SU(2)ₖ Chern-Simons理论），并扩展到异常任意子情形，展示了该方法的普适性。
AI.conclusion: SymTFT提供了一种系统的、统一的框架来构造任意子凝聚相变，可处理包括非阿贝尔和异常任意子在内的广泛拓扑序。

title: Spin-polarized supercurrents and Josephson diode effect in altermagnets
comment: 18 pages main text, 5 pages supplemental materials, 10 figures in total
summary: We present a systematic theoretical study of the Josephson effect in junctions consisting of a d-wave altermagnet (AM) placed between two BCS superconductors (SC). In general, the SC/AM interfaces are spin-active and modeled by spin-dependent $δ$ potentials, allowing for an arbitrary direction of the local exchange field vector. The model is formulated within the fully quantum (Gor'kov) and quasiclassical (Eilenberger) Green's function technique, applied to two distinct cases of (i) a weakly spin-polarized AM (exchange field much smaller compared to the Fermi energy) and (ii) a strongly spin-polarized AM (exchange field comparable to the Fermi energy). We apply our model to the SC/AM/SC geometry, accounting for the Josephson current-phase relation (CPR). In the weakly spin-polarized regime, the CPR displays the normal Josephson effect. Irrespective of the orientation of the altermagnet, the junction undergoes the $0-π$ transition. Depending on the orientation, the system displays the features similar to those of a ferromagnetic or an antiferromagnetic junction. To investigate the spin-polarized currents and nonreciprocal transport as the central results of the present work, we put the main focus on the strongly spin-polarized regime. Within this regime, we distinguish two cases. A coplanar exchange field profile across the junctions displays the normal Josephson effect; however, with a pure and stable long-range second harmonic in the CPR. In contrast, a noncoplanar exchange field profile gives rise to the so-called quantum geometric phases across the junction, leading to the absence of the phase-inversion center in the Josephson CPR. As a result, a Josephson diode effect emerges with a significant charge diode efficiency larger than 30% and a perfect spin diode efficiency of 100%.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了夹在两个BCS超导体之间的d波交错磁体(AM)约瑟夫森结。利用完全量子格林函数(Gor'kov)和准经典格林函数(Eilenberger)技术，区分弱自旋极化和强自旋极化两种情形。弱极化时表现为正常约瑟夫森效应并伴随0-π转变；强极化时，共面交换场产生稳定长程二次谐波，而非共面交换场引发量子几何相位，实现约瑟夫森二极管效应，电荷二极管效率超30%，自旋二极管效率达100%。
AI.motivation: 交错磁体(Altermagnet)是近年来新发现的一种磁性材料类别，其能带自旋劈裂具有d波对称性，兼具铁磁和反铁磁特性。研究其与超导体的约瑟夫森结物理，对于理解新型自旋电子学物理和开发超导二极管器件具有重要意义，但目前对该方向的理论研究仍较为缺乏。
AI.method: 采用完全量子的Gor'kov格林函数技术和准经典的Eilenberger格林函数技术，对SC/AM/SC约瑟夫森结进行系统建模。SC/AM界面用自旋相关δ势建模，允许局域交换场方向任意。分别处理弱自旋极化（交换场远小于费米能）和强自旋极化（交换场接近费米能）两种情形，并计算约瑟夫森电流-相位关系(CPR)。
AI.result: (1) 弱自旋极化区：无论交错磁体取向如何，CPR显示正常约瑟夫森效应并发生0-π转变，且展现出类似于铁磁或反铁磁结的特征。(2) 强自旋极化区-共面交换场：表现为正常约瑟夫森效应，但CPR中出现纯且稳定的长程二次谐波。(3) 强自旋极化区-非共面交换场：产生量子几何相位，CPR失去相位反转中心，出现约瑟夫森二极管效应，电荷二极管效率超30%，自旋二极管效率达100%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作系统揭示了交错磁体约瑟夫森结的丰富物理现象，特别是在强自旋极化非共面交换场配置下实现了高效的约瑟夫森二极管效应（电荷效率>30%，自旋效率100%），为自旋电子学和超导二极管器件的发展提供了坚实的理论框架和新颖的物理见解。

title: Accurate Evaluation of Nanoscale Spatiotemporal Dynamics with Electron Correlation Microscopy
summary: Electron correlation microscopy (ECM) can measure materials dynamics with nanoscale spatial resolution from intensity correlation functions. However, adopting X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy (XPCS) normalization frameworks unchanged when calculating intensity correlations can introduce errors. Due to the constrained sampling volumes and larger speckle sizes in nanobeam electron diffraction, XPCS-style time-averaging and scattering-vector averaging introduce systematic artifacts, such as artificial anticorrelations or elevated baselines that lead to systematic errors in structural relaxation times and stretching exponents. This work presents physics-inspired, ECM-specific intensity normalizations over time- and azimuthal-averaged intensities of the first diffraction ring that limit those errors. The framework is validated using molecular dynamics simulations of a CuZr supercooled liquid to benchmark against the self intermediate scattering function, successfully reproducing relaxation times. When applied to experimental time-resolved 4D STEM datasets of a Pt57.5Cu14.7Ni5.3P22.5 nanowire, the method correctly identifies highly stable, unchanging nanoscale crystalline phases that were erroneously misclassified as relaxing domains by previous frameworks. Other previous ECM research is reevaluated in light of these observation. This robust approach establishes an artifact-free pathway for evaluating localized spatiotemporal relaxation behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种电子关联显微镜（ECM）专用的强度归一化框架，以解决直接借用XPCS归一化方法在纳米束电子衍射中引入的系统性伪影（如人工反相关、基线抬升），并通过MD模拟和4D STEM实验验证其在测量纳米尺度材料动力学和结构弛豫时间上的准确性。
AI.motivation: ECM利用强度关联函数测量纳米尺度材料动力学，但直接沿用XPCS的归一化框架会因受限采样体积和更大散斑尺寸引入系统性伪影，导致弛豫时间和拉伸指数出现误差，甚至将稳定晶相误判为弛豫域。
AI.method: 提出物理启发的ECM专用强度归一化方法，对第一衍射环的时间平均和方位角平均强度进行归一化处理，以限制系统误差；通过CuZr过冷液体的分子动力学模拟进行验证，并与中间散射函数基准对比。
AI.result: 该方法在MD模拟中成功复现弛豫时间；应用于Pt57.5Cu14.7Ni5.3P22.5纳米线的4D STEM实验数据时，正确识别出先前被误分类为弛豫域的稳定纳米晶相，并对此前ECM研究进行了重新评估。
AI.conclusion: 该归一化框架提供了一条无伪影的路径，用于评估局域时空弛豫行为，为ECM测量纳米尺度材料动力学建立了更可靠的定量基础。

title: Shortcuts to Parameter Sweeps
comment: 6 pages main text, 2 figures; 11 pages supplemental material
summary: Efficient evaluation of stationary parametric sensitivities over broad parameter ranges is important for identifying influential training data, fitting force fields, and predicting material responses, but standard pointwise approaches require repeated relaxation and sampling. Here we introduce Shortcuts to Parameter Sweeps (STPS), an engineered control strategy that uses an auxiliary control to transport the probability density along a prescribed family of instantaneous stationary states during a finite-time parameter sweep. This enables the continuous response curve over the full parameter interval to be estimated from a single controlled sweep using covariance-based response relations. STPS applies to both equilibrium and nonequilibrium steady-state systems, including those with unknown stationary distributions, and can be implemented directly using stationary samples in high-dimensional settings. Numerical tests on single-particle and interacting many-body systems show that STPS yields response curves in close agreement with reference results. These findings establish STPS as an efficient, sample-based framework for continuous sensitivity analysis in stochastic simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STPS（参数扫描捷径）方法，通过辅助控制将概率密度沿参数族的瞬时稳态进行输运，从而在单次控制扫描中估计完整参数区间上的连续响应曲线，适用于平衡态和非平衡稳态系统。
AI.motivation: 参数敏感性分析在识别重要训练数据、拟合力场和预测材料响应中至关重要，但标准的逐点方法需要在每个参数点重复进行弛豫和采样，效率低下，尤其在大范围参数扫描场景下成本高昂。
