title: Probing Impurity Quantum Criticality with Entanglement Witnesses
summary: Entanglement is a defining feature of quantum mechanics, and its relation to quantum criticality is of considerable current interest. Here we show that measurable spin and charge fluctuations provide an entanglement witness of quantum criticality in the two-impurity Kondo model, which has experimental realizations in terms of coupled quantum dots and magnetic impurities added to surfaces. We use density-matrix renormalization group and numerical renormalization group calculations to resolve the non-Fermi-liquid critical point separating two independently Kondo-screened impurities from an inter-impurity singlet and interpret it as a change in the dominant entanglement partner of each local moment: from entanglement of the local moment with an extended set of conduction-electron degrees of freedom to entanglement with the other impurity. This reorganization is accompanied by a singular response of the impurity-bath entanglement and the inter-impurity susceptibility. We show how the same structure is encoded in the quantum Fisher information of collective spin and charge operators at zero and finite temperatures, connecting the entanglement picture to experimentally accessible dynamical response functions. Our results establish impurity systems as controlled settings in which quantum-critical entanglement can be detected through measurable correlations, and provide further insight into the possibility of understanding heavy-fermion physics in terms of entanglement.

AI.tldr: 本文通过可测量的自旋和电荷涨落作为纠缠见证，研究了双杂质Kondo模型中的量子临界性。利用DMRG和NRG计算，作者解析了非费米液体临界点，并将其解释为局域磁矩主导纠缠伙伴的改变：从与扩展导带电子自由度的纠缠转变为与另一杂质的纠缠。这种重组伴随着杂质-浴纠缠和杂质间磁化率的奇异响应，并通过量子Fisher信息将其与实验可访问的动力学响应函数联系起来。
AI.motivation: 纠缠是量子力学的定义性特征，但其与量子临界性的关系是当前的研究热点。作者希望在可实验实现的双杂质Kondo系统中，建立纠缠与量子临界性之间的可检测联系，并为理解重费米子物理提供纠缠视角的洞见。
AI.method: 采用密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）和数值重整化群（NRG）计算方法，解析两个独立Kondo屏蔽杂质与杂质间单重态之间的非费米液体临界点；利用量子Fisher信息编码集体自旋和电荷算符在零温和有限温下的纠缠结构，将其连接到实验可访问的动力学响应函数。
AI.result: 自旋和电荷涨落可作为量子临界性的纠缠见证；临界点的本质是局域磁矩主导纠缠伙伴的重组——从与导带电子纠缠转变为与另一杂质纠缠；该重组伴随杂质-浴纠缠和杂质间磁化率的奇异响应。
AI.conclusion: 杂质系统可作为受控平台，通过可测量的关联检测量子临界纠缠，并为通过纠缠视角理解重费米子物理提供了新的可能性。

title: Soft-Phonon-Driven Effective Inversion-Symmetry Crossover in Quantum Paraelectrics
summary: Symmetry lays the foundation of condensed matter physics and its experimental manifestation provides fundamental insight into the collective behaviors of quantum materials. Optical second-harmonic generation (SHG) is widely regarded as a fingerprint of inversion-symmetry breaking, yet whether and how collective lattice dynamics govern the nonlinear optical manifestation of local inversion-symmetry breaking remains unknown. Here, combining optical SHG, diffuse X-ray scattering, and microscopic theory, we reveal a phonon-regulated mechanism governing the temperature-dependent manifestation of local inversion-symmetry breaking in quantum paraelectric material KTaO3. We demonstrate that an oxygen-defect-mediated nonlinear optical channel is strongly coupled to the host soft polar mode, whose thermal fluctuations scramble the associated electronic phase coherence and thereby suppress the nonlinear manifestation of local inversion-symmetry breaking at elevated temperatures. Consequently, the nonlinear response exhibits a temperature-driven crossover from a regime in which local inversion-symmetry breaking is optically manifest to one that appears effectively centrosymmetric, without any accompanying structural change. Our findings revise the conventional picture of the temperature-dependent manifestation of inversion-symmetry breaking in quantum paraelectrics and establish a framework for understanding and engineering defect-mediated nonlinear optical responses in materials hosting low-energy polar excitations.

AI.tldr: 该研究结合光学二次谐波产生（SHG）、漫散射X射线和微观理论，揭示了量子顺电材料KTaO3中声子调控的局域反演对称性破缺的温度依赖性表现机制。研究发现氧缺陷介导的非线性光学通道与软极性声子强耦合，热涨落通过扰乱电子相位相干性抑制局域反演对称性破缺的非线性表现，导致非线性响应出现无结构变化的温度驱动交叉行为。
AI.motivation: SHG被广泛视为反演对称性破缺的特征信号，但集体晶格动力学如何调控局域反演对称性破缺的非线性光学表现尚不清楚。理解这一机制对量子顺电材料和非线性光学研究具有重要意义。
AI.method: 将光学SHG、漫散射X射线和微观理论三种手段相结合，系统研究KTaO3中局域反演对称性破缺随温度变化的表现机制，重点分析氧缺陷介导的非线性光学通道与软极性声子的耦合关系。
AI.result: 发现氧缺陷介导的非线性光学通道与宿主软极性声子强耦合，软极性声子的热涨落扰乱电子相位相干性，从而在高温下抑制局域反演对称性破缺的非线性表现。非线性响应呈现温度驱动的交叉行为：从局域反演对称性破缺可光学显现的区域转变为看似有效中心对称的区域，且无伴随的结构变化。
AI.conclusion: 该研究修正了量子顺电体中反演对称性破缺温度依赖性的传统认知，建立了理解和工程化含有低能极性激发的材料中缺陷介导非线性光学响应的框架。

title: Magnetic noise of a dark exciton Bose-Einstein condensate
summary: Excitons provide a promising platform for the realization of solid-state Bose-Einstein condensation (BEC), offering quantum coherence, strongly correlated electron-hole physics, and superfluidity. Yet, its unambiguous experimental identification remains challenging. In particular, $S_z= \pm 1$ triplet excitons are excellent candidates to realize an exciton BEC, because of their intrinsically limited recombination rate and thus long lifetimes. However, since their optical detection is inherently forbidden, experimental signatures remain elusive. In this work, we demonstrate that the magnetic nature of a $S_z= \pm 1$ triplet exciton BEC gives rise to stray magnetic field noise, that can be measured using nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center magnetometry. Using an external magnetic field to tune the system from an antiferromagnetic to a ferromagnetic ordering, the longitudinal spin sound mode of the BEC softens, bringing the mode into the characteristic gigahertz frequency range of the NV spin relaxation rate and thus allowing direct detection. Furthermore, we demonstrate an unconventional UV scaling at small distances $d$ from the sample, owing to the cubic corrections to the sound mode dispersion and damping rate in the form of Beliaev damping. Through this approach, we establish that the spin component of exciton BECs offers new approaches to detect exciton BECs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用氮-空位（NV）中心磁强计检测激子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）所产生的杂散磁场噪声，通过外部磁场调控系统从反铁磁到铁磁有序转变，使自旋声学模软化进入GHz频率范围从而实现直接探测。
AI.motivation: 三重态激子（S_z=±1）因寿命长是激子BEC的理想候选者，但其光学探测被禁止，实验信号难以获取，亟需新的探测方法。

AI.conclusion: 激子BEC的自旋分量提供了检测激子BEC的新途径，为固体BEC的实验识别开辟了新的方向。

title: Finite-depth scaling and an exact Bernoulli-leaf identity for the min-plus process on the binary tree
summary: The min-plus process is a stochastic coagulation-annihilation-type process on the binary tree, of interest in mathematics, physics, and computer science as a tractable instance of max-type recursive distributional equations. We carry out large Monte Carlo simulations at effective tree depths up to $N=60$ that provide finite-depth corroboration of the Beta(2,1) stretched-exponential limit for its root value $X_{N}$ at $p=1/2$, on the asymmetric $\sqrt{N}$ side of the random-homogeneous-systems classification recently introduced by Chen, Duquesne, and Shi and by Morfe. Off criticality, our simulations confirm the sub-critical closed form $\mathbb{P}(X_{\infty}=1)=(1-2p)/(1-p)$ within Monte Carlo error and document a super-critical mean growth exceeding the elementary $(2p)^{N}$ lower bound at the depths we reach. For a Bernoulli($q$)-initial-condition variant, we identify an elementary closed-form identity at $p=1/2$ that pins down the order parameter $\mathbb{P}(X_{N}=0)=q$ exactly, locates the absorbing-state phase transition at $p_{c}=1/2$ in the operator-mixing probability rather than in the initial-zero density, and shows that the conditional law on positives deforms substantially with $q$. Our simulations use a level-wise recursion and an FFT-based precomputed leaf table which reduce the effective simulation depth while preserving the recursive tree law and may be useful for the simulation of related recursive equations on large trees.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模蒙特卡洛模拟（有效树深度达N=60）研究了二叉树上的min-plus随机凝聚-湮灭过程，验证了p=1/2时根值服从Beta(2,1)拉伸指数极限，确认了次临界态的闭式概率公式，并发现超临界均值增长超过初等下界。此外，对Bernoulli(q)初值变体提出了精确闭式恒等式，定位了吸收态相变。
AI.motivation: min-plus过程是数学、物理和计算机科学中具有代表性的max型递归分布方程的可处理实例，其极限行为与相变特性具有重要理论意义，需要通过大规模数值模拟对已有理论分类和极限结果进行有限深度层面的验证。
AI.method: 采用大规模蒙特卡洛模拟，有效树深度达N=60；在p=1/2时于非对称√N侧验证Beta(2,1)拉伸指数极限；同时引入基于FFT的预计算叶表与逐层递归算法，降低有效模拟深度同时保持递归树分布律。
AI.result: 1) p=1/2时在有效深度上验证了Beta(2,1)拉伸指数极限；2) 次临界时闭式P(X∞=1)=(1-2p)/(1-p)在蒙特卡洛误差内得到确认；3) 超临界均值增长在可达深度内超过(2p)^N初等下界；4) 对Bernoulli(q)初值变体，在p=1/2处找到精确闭式恒等式P(X_N=0)=q，并定位相变在算子混合概率p_c=1/2而非初始零密度处。

title: Emergent heavy fermion and superconductivity near Mott transition in twisted bilayer graphene
summary: Near a bandwidth-tuned Mott transition, the Fermi velocity $v_F$ and quasiparticle residue $Z$ of a metal often vanish. Here, we show that analogous phenomena emerge in twisted bilayer graphene (TBG) at integer fillings and can be captured by an emergent heavy-fermion framework within a projective active-band limit. Unlike models incorporating remote bands, our effective heavy-fermion description arises from \textit{mixed-valence Mott} physics via decoupled charge and local-moment sectors. In the charge sector, active bands $c(\mathbf{k})$ hybridize with an emergent \emph{orthogonal fermion} $ψ(\mathbf{k})$ to open a large Mott gap at $|\mathbf{k}| > k_*$ ($k_*$ sets the momentum-patch size) and a quadratic band-touching semimetal near $\mathbf{k}=0$ at neutrality ($ν=0$). The orthogonal fermion is a linear combination of the doublon and holon excitations and may be written as $ψ_i \sim (δn^f_i+\frac{1}{2})^{-1} f_i$. An emergent Kondo coupling $J_K \sim U$ ($U$ is the local Hubbard interaction) between $ψ$ and local moments $ψ'$ frames the Mott transition as a Kondo screening transition, tuned by the twist angle $θ$. Away from the magic angle, a Kondo-screened heavy semimetal develops below $T_K$ (the Kondo temperature) with vanishing $Z$. Introducing anti-Hund's coupling $J_A$ generates an s-wave fully gapped or nematic, nodally gapped superconducting dome near the Mott boundary even at $ν=0$. At other integer fillings $ν= \pm 1, \pm 2$, increasing bandwidth first drives the small-gap Mott state into an intermediate quadratic band-touching semimetal before entering a heavy Fermi liquid with large Fermi surfaces. Our results establish a unified framework for emergent heavy fermion physics with both itinerant carriers and local moments from the $f$ orbital.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的重费米子框架来描述转角双层石墨烯（TBG）在整数填充下的莫特物理，该框架基于投影主动带极限下的混合价态莫特机制，将莫特转变重新诠释为Kondo屏蔽转变，并预言了超导圆顶、二次能带接触半金属等多种有趣现象。
AI.motivation: 在带宽调谐的莫特转变附近，金属的费米速度和准粒子残余常常消失。作者希望证明在TBG整数填充下也存在类似现象，并建立一个不依赖远端能带的有效重费米子描述框架，以统一理解TBG中巡游载流子与局域磁矩（f轨道）之间相互作用的物理。
AI.method: 作者采用投影主动带极限下的有效重费米子框架，通过解耦电荷和局域磁矩扇区来实现混合价态莫特物理。具体而言，主动带c(k)与涌现的"正交费米子"ψ(k)杂化打开大Mott能隙（|k|>k_*）并在k=0附近形成二次能带接触半金属。正交费米子ψ是双占据子和空穴激发的线性组合，形式为ψ_i ~ (δn^f_i+1/2)^{-1} f_i。涌现的Kondo耦合J_K~U（U为局域Hubbard相互作用）将莫特转变框架化为由转角θ调谐的Kondo屏蔽转变，并引入反Hund耦合J_A以产生超导圆顶。
AI.result: 1) 在非魔角处，Kondo屏蔽的重半金属在T_K以下出现，且Z消失；2) 引入反Hund耦合J_A后，在莫特边界附近ν=0处出现s波全能隙或向列型节线能隙超导圆顶；3) 在其他整数填充ν=±1,±2处，增大带宽首先将小能隙Mott态驱动为中间二次能带接触半金属，再进入具有大费米面的重费米液体。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了统一的重费米子物理框架，同时包含巡游载流子和来自f轨道的局域磁矩，为理解TBG在整数填充下的莫特转变、Kondo屏蔽、重费米液体及超导提供了新的理论视角，并可推广到其他强关联量子材料。

title: Advances and opportunities for automated robotic preparation of 2D materials and fabrication of 2D heterostructures
summary: The mechanical exfoliation, transfer, and stacking of 2D atomic sheets from van der Waals crystals synergize to enable atomic layer-by-atomic layer engineering of 2D heterostructures with tailored properties that yield new exotic phenomena and states of matter. With the huge variety of van der Waals materials available, there is a limitless number of ways to couple 2D semiconducting, insulating, magnetic, metallic, topological, etc. systems with one another. Experimental exploration of this vast space starts with the fabrication of high-quality 2D heterostructures, which is commonly performed manually, relying on humans to execute delicate operations. Many scientific advancements have been achieved in this manner, revealing immense potential for further discovery and innovation of increasingly sophisticated 2D heterostructures. However, soon, the complexity of the 2D heterostructures that define the scientific state-of-the-art will exceed the capabilities of manual fabrication. Therefore, the demand for robotic instruments for preparing 2D materials and fabricating complex 2D heterostructures with greater quality, at higher rates, and with better reproducibility is increasing. This review covers recent scientific, instrumentation, and processing advances rising to this challenge. Robotic instruments for mechanical exfoliation, optical metrology of 2D crystallites, stacking, as well as advancements in supporting technologies such as organic-free stamps, vacuum-compatible processing tools, and artificial intelligence (AI) are covered. Looking forward, a new generation of AI-driven, automated advanced manufacturing tools is anticipated to emerge from these current advancements. These new tools will bridge the current state-of-the-art of 2D heterostructure science to new scientific frontiers defined by precision fabrication of high-quality, complex, many-layer 2D heterostructure systems.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了2D异质结构制备从手工操作向机器人自动化制造的转变，涵盖机械剥离、光学计量、堆叠等机器人仪器（如无有机残留的印章、真空兼容工具）以及人工智能技术的应用，并展望了AI驱动的自动化先进制造工具将推动高复杂度、高质量多层2D异质结构的精密制造。

AI.method: 本文为综述型论文，系统回顾了近期在机器人机械剥离、2D微晶光学计量、自动堆叠等关键技术上的科学和仪器进展，以及有机-free印章、真空兼容处理工具和人工智能等支撑技术的进步。

title: Quantum Anomalous Hall Effect in $d^{10}$ Oxide Monolayers
summary: Quantum anomalous Hall effect (QAHE) arises from the interplay between magnetic order and spin-orbit coupling, which opens up a topologically nontrivial band gap to host chiral edge states in the absence of magnetic field. So far, magnetic order of QAHE usually originates from partially filled transition-metal $d$ orbitals or correlation-driven moiré bands. Here, we propose an experimentally accessible family of two-dimensional oxides, M$_2$DO$_6$ (M = Zn, Cd; D = Se, Te), that can realize QAHE from the half-filled O-$2p$ orbital induced spontaneous ferromagnetism. In M$_2$DO$_6$ monolayers, spin-polarized Dirac points appear at K/K$^{\prime}$ valleys and along $Γ$-K/$Γ$-K$^{\prime}$ lines. $C_3$ rotational symmetry then generates eight symmetry-related crossings in the first Brillouin zone. Upon gap opening by spin-orbit coupling, each massive Dirac point contributes half Chern number, resulting in a high-Chern-number QAHE phase with $\mathcal{C}=4$. We establish cation deintercalation as a general strategy to activate O-$2p$ ferromagnetism in oxides. Our finding provides a route to realize QAHE from O-$2p$ ferromagnetism and offers design principles applicable to oxygen-based magnetic topology platforms beyond conventional $d$-electron systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一类实验可行的二维氧化物M₂DO₆（M = Zn, Cd; D = Se, Te），通过半填充O-2p轨道诱导的自发铁磁性实现量子反常霍尔效应（QAHE）。该体系中自旋极化的狄拉克点出现在K/K′谷和Γ-K/Γ-K′线上，自旋轨道耦合打开能隙后每个巨大狄拉克点贡献半个陈数，最终形成陈数C=4的高陈数量子反常霍尔效应相。阳离子脱嵌被确立为激活氧化物中O-2p铁磁性的一般策略。
AI.motivation: 传统QAHE的铁磁性来源通常依赖过渡金属d轨道或莫尔带，本文旨在探索一种全新的物理机制——利用O-2p轨道自发铁磁性实现量子反常霍尔效应，突破传统d电子体系的局限，为氧化物磁性拓扑平台提供新的设计原理。
AI.method: 提出M₂DO₆（M = Zn, Cd; D = Se, Te）二维氧化物单层体系，通过阳离子脱嵌策略激活O-2p轨道的自发铁磁性。利用自旋极化的狄拉克点在布里渊区中形成八个对称相关的交义点，通过自旋轨道耦合打开能隙，每个巨大狄拉克点贡献半个陈数，从而获得C=4的高陈数QAHE相。
AI.result: 在M₂DO₆单层中实现了由O-2p轨道铁磁性驱动的QAHE，自旋轨道耦合打开能隙后形成陈数C=4的高陈数量子反常霍尔效应相。阳离子脱嵌被证明是激活氧化物O-2p铁磁性的通用策略。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一条从O-2p铁磁性实现QAHE的新途径，其设计原理可推广至超越传统d电子体系的氧基磁性拓扑平台，为二维磁性拓扑材料的设计开辟了新方向。

title: Interface phases and dynamics in two-dimensional quantum magnets: A "holographic" approach from universality to quantum simulation
summary: We introduce a framework to classify quantum phases, phase transitions, and non-equilibrium dynamics of interfaces separating ordered bulk domains in 2D quantum magnets - equivalently, confining strings in dual lattice gauge theories - based on effective 1D Hamiltonians governing geometric fluctuations. Building on a "holographic" approach from [Phys. Rev. Lett. 129, 120601 (2022)], here reinterpreted as an exact bosonization, we uncover a rich quantum phase structure, with a variety of stiff and rough interface phases described by gapped and gapless 1D ground states, respectively, all distinguishable through the statistics of 2D wave-function snapshots. Our framework allows us to predict distinct spatiotemporal scaling laws for non-equilibrium curvature-driven interface dynamics across parameter space, which can be readily probed in existing experiments. We finally show that our approach enables the unprecedented experimental opportunity of directly measuring charge full counting statistics and symmetry-resolved properties of an encoded 1D system, as we explicitly demonstrate by numerically simulating a neutral-atom array experiment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一框架，用于分类二维量子磁体中分离有序体域界面的量子相、相变及非平衡动力学（等效于对偶规范理论中的约束弦），基于控制几何涨落的有效一维哈密顿量。该方法将先前"全息"方法与精确玻色化重新关联，揭示了丰富量子相结构，包括有隙/无隙的刚性界面相和粗糙界面相，可通过二维波函数快照的统计特征区分。框架还预测了非平衡曲率驱动界面动力学的时空标度律，并展示了直接测量编码一维系统电荷全计数统计与对称分辨性质的实验可能性。
AI.motivation: 量子磁体中界面（或对偶规范理论中的约束弦）的分类此前缺乏系统框架，且该领域常见方法多局限于平衡态属性。作者希望建立一个基于有效一维哈密顿量的统一理论框架，既能分类静态量子相和相变，又能预测非平衡界面动力学，同时揭示其与可测QED性质的深层联系。
AI.method: 将界面几何涨落映射为有效一维量子哈密顿量，并利用源自PRL 129, 120601 (2022)的"全息"方法，将其重新解释为精确玻色化。通过分析一维基态（有隙/无隙）来区分刚性和粗糙界面相，利用二维波函数快照统计进行实验鉴别；并推导非平衡曲率驱动动力学的时空标度律，最终通过数值模拟中性原子阵列实验验证电荷全计数统计与对称分辨性质的直接测量方案。
AI.result: 揭示出丰富的量子相结构，包含由有隙一维基态描述的多种刚性界面相和由无隙基态描述的粗糙界面相。框架导出了随参数空间变化的不同非平衡界面动力学标度律，并通过中性原子阵列数值模拟证实了可直接测量编码一维系统的电荷全计数统计与对称分辨性质。
AI.conclusion: 该框架不仅统一了二维量子磁体界面（约束弦）的量子相分类和动力学预测，还开辟了前所未有的实验途径——通过二维系统直接观测编码的一维系统的完整统计性质，为量子模拟和量子信息研究提供了新工具。

title: Magnetoelastic coupling descriptor for high-throughput ab initio search of magnetocaloric materials
summary: We use Landau theory of phase transitions to design a magnetoelastic coupling descriptor that can identify magnetic materials on the brink of a first-order transition, where a strong magnetocaloric effect (MCE) can arise. The descriptor can be computed from electronic structure calculations and requires structural optimization in the paramagnetic state, which we model using special quasi-random collinear spin configurations. We first evaluate the descriptor for a set of known magnetocaloric materials and identify compounds in which the MCE is driven by magnetoelastic coupling. We then apply the descriptor in a high-throughput \emph{ab initio} screening of magnetic L1$_2$ compounds. This search identifies the L1$_2$ cubic phases of Mn$_3$Ge and Mn$_3$Sb as materials with strong magnetoelastic coupling and potential for a large magnetocaloric response.

AI.tldr: 本文利用朗道相变理论设计了一个磁弹耦合描述符，用于识别处于一级相变临界状态、可能具有强磁热效应的磁性材料。该描述符可通过电子结构计算得出，并在高通量筛选L1₂化合物时发现了Mn₃Ge和Mn₃Sb两种具有强磁弹耦合潜力的材料。
AI.motivation: 磁热效应在一级相变附近最为显著，但传统方法难以高效识别处于相变临界状态的候选材料。作者希望通过设计一个可计算的描述符，实现高通量筛选具有强磁热效应的磁性材料。
AI.method: 基于朗道相变理论设计磁弹耦合描述符；使用特殊准随机共线自旋构型模拟顺磁态并进行结构优化；先在已知磁热材料上验证描述符，再将其应用于L1₂化合物的高通量从头算筛选中。
AI.result: 描述符在已知磁热材料上得到验证，能够区分由磁弹耦合驱动的磁热效应；高通量筛选发现L1₂立方相的Mn₃Ge和Mn₃Sb具有强磁弹耦合和大的磁热响应潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该磁弹耦合描述符是一种有效的计算工具，可用于高通量发现具有强磁热效应潜力的新材料，并成功鉴别出Mn₃Ge和Mn₃Sb作为有前景的磁热材料候选。

title: Dimensional crossover and local strain induced deflection of the spin spiral state in multiferroic NiI2
summary: Low-dimensional multiferroics hold great promise for integrated magnetoelectric devices. Spin spiral state has recently been shown to induce ferroelectricity in single-layer van der Waals (vdW) material NiI2. However, how this state evolves and can be tuned towards the two-dimensional limit remain unclear. Here, we combine spin-polarized scanning tunneling microscopy, layer-by-layer film growth, and multi-scale theoretical modeling to investigate the spin spirals in NiI2 thin films. As the film thickness increases from 1 to 7 monolayers, we observed a continuous increase of spin-spiral wavelength and a rotation of wavevector from near [110] to [1-10] direction, which evidences a dimensional crossover primarily driven by enhanced interlayer exchange energy. Moreover, we find that the film wrinkles can cause deflection of the spin spiral wavevector, which is caused by local curvature induced modification of exchange interactions. Our findings establish thickness and local strain as two tuning methods for engineering non-collinear helical magnetism and accompanied electric polarization in vdW multiferroics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结合自旋极化扫描隧道显微镜、逐层薄膜生长和多尺度理论建模，研究了NiI2薄膜中自旋螺旋态随厚度从1到7个单层的变化规律，发现螺旋波长连续增加且波矢发生旋转，同时揭示了薄膜褶皱可通过局部曲率调控交换作用使波矢偏转，确立了厚度和局域应变两种调控方法。
AI.motivation: 低维多铁材料在集成磁电器件中具有巨大潜力，单层NiI2中自旋螺旋态已被证明可诱导铁电性，但该态在向二维极限演化过程中的变化规律及调控方式尚不清楚。
AI.method: 结合自旋极化扫描隧道显微镜（SP-STM）观测、逐层薄膜生长技术以及多尺度理论建模，系统研究NiI2薄膜中自旋螺旋的演化行为。
AI.result: 发现随薄膜厚度从1增加到7个单层，自旋螺旋波长连续增大且波矢从[110]方向旋转至[1-10]方向，这是由层间交换能增强驱动的维度交叉现象；此外，薄膜褶皱引起的局部曲率会改性交换相互作用，导致自旋螺旋波矢发生偏转。
AI.conclusion: 确立了厚度和局域应变两种调控非共线螺旋磁性及伴随电极化的方法，为在vdW多铁材料中工程设计磁性结构提供了新途径。

title: First-principles cumulant approach to the vibronic structure of spin defects
summary: Color centers in wide-band-gap semiconductors are leading platforms for solid-state quantum technologies, yet a quantitative description of their vibronic structure has remained elusive due to the complexity of multi-phonon processes in localized defect states. Here we present a first-principles Green's function framework based on the retarded cumulant ansatz (RCA) to describe electron-phonon interactions in spin defects; our approach goes beyond the adiabatic and lowest-order perturbation theory approximations underlying widely used approaches. Applied to the negatively charged nitrogen-vacancy (NV$^-$) center in diamond, our method reveals that multi-phonon satellites persist over a 400 meV energy window even at zero temperature, driven by quantum zero-point fluctuations. We demonstrate that accurate spectral functions require mode-, momentum-, spin-, and orbital-resolved electron-phonon matrix elements sampled across the full Brillouin zone, to account for hybridized and propagating phonon channels. We find that the vibronic structure of the NV$^-$ center exhibits strong spin and orbital anisotropy, with different orbitals coupling to qualitatively distinct parts of the phonon spectrum, and spin-selective coupling affecting both sideband positions and intensities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于延迟累积量近似（RCA）的第一性原理Green函数框架，用于描述自旋缺陷中的电子-声子相互作用，并应用于金刚石中带负电的氮空位（NV⁻）中心，揭示了多声子伴线在零温下仍存在、振动结构具有强自旋和轨道各向异性等关键发现。
AI.motivation: 宽禁带半导体中的色心是固态量子技术的前沿平台，但其振动结构的定量描述一直困难重重，主要源于局域缺陷态中多声子过程的复杂性。现有的广泛使用的方法（如绝热近似和最低阶微扰理论）不足以准确描述这类系统中的电子-声子相互作用。
AI.method: 作者提出了基于延迟累积量近似（RCA）的第一性原理Green函数框架，该框架超越了绝热近似和最低阶微扰理论的限制。他们需要计算全布里渊区内模式、动量、自旋和轨道分辨的电子-声子矩阵元，以考虑杂化的和传播的声子通道。
AI.result: 应用于金刚石NV⁻中心后发现：（1）即使零温下，多声子伴线在400 meV能量窗口内持续存在，由量子零点涨落驱动；（2）精确的谱函数需要全布里渊区采样的模式、动量、自旋和轨道分辨的电子-声子矩阵元；（3）NV⁻中心的振动结构表现出强烈的自旋和轨道各向异性，不同轨道耦合到声子谱中性质不同的部分，自旋选择性耦合同时影响伴线位置和强度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为固态量子缺陷中电子-声子相互作用的定量描述提供了超越传统近似的新框架，揭示了NV⁻中心振动结构的各向异性本质，对理解和调控色心量子光学性质具有重要指导意义。

title: Mismatch between Raman shear modes and ferroelectric polarization in 3R-MoS$_{2}$
summary: Sliding ferroelectricity in parallel-stacked two-dimensional van der Waals materials enables a broad range of novel device concepts, but exploiting it requires reliable, non-destructive assignment of the underlying stacking order and polarization state. Here, we combine Kelvin-probe force microscopy (KPFM) with low-frequency Raman spectroscopy to probe the polarization domains and stacking configurations of a exfoliated trilayer 3R-MoS$_{2}$ flake on a hBN substrate. We find that ABA and BAB - both stackings with zero net polarization - are indistinguishable in KPFM, yet show drastically different low-frequency shear modes. This observation is reproduced across multiple flakes and is corroborated by low-temperature photoluminescence. Notably, the standard bond-polarizability model does not account for the difference in shear-mode activity between the ABA and BAB configurations, indicating that the interlayer Raman response of these stackings is governed by physics beyond a simple polarizability picture. Our results show that none of the here-used individual techniques alone is sufficient to assign sliding-ferroelectric stacking order and motivate a combined spectroscopic-scanning-probe approach.

AI.tldr: 本文结合开尔文探针力显微镜（KPFM）与低频拉曼光谱，对hBN基底上的外延三层3R-MoS2薄片进行表征，发现零净极化的ABA和BAB堆叠在KPFM中不可区分，但低频剪切模显著不同，表明单一技术不足以确定滑移铁电堆叠序，需采用光谱-扫描探针联合方法。
AI.motivation: 滑移铁电在平行堆叠的二维范德华材料中可实现多种新型器件概念，但可靠、无损地确定堆叠序和极化态是开发利用这些概念的前提，而现有单一表征手段存在局限性。
AI.method: 将开尔文探针力显微镜（KPFM）与低频拉曼光谱相结合，对外延三层3R-MoS2薄片（置于hBN基底上）的极化畴和堆叠构型进行系统表征，并辅以低温光致发光验证。
AI.result: ABA和BAB两种零净极化堆叠在KPFM中无法区分，但显示出截然不同的低频剪切模；该现象在多个薄片上可重复，并得到低温光致发光的佐证。标准键极化率模型无法解释ABA与BAB构型间剪切模活性的差异。
AI.conclusion: 任何单一技术（KPFM或拉曼光谱）均不足以独立确定滑移铁电堆叠序，需采用光谱-扫描探针联合表征策略；同时指出层间拉曼响应由超越简单极化率图像的物理机制所支配。

title: Deep-Learning-Accelerated Dopant Selection for High-k HfO2 Dielectrics: A Disorder-Resolved Study of Y, Si and Al
summary: Hafnium oxide (HfO2) is the cornerstone high-k dielectric in modern silicon technology. Since the constraints of silicon device fabrication rule out replacing the material itself, dopant incorporation is the principal means available to engineer its band gap and dielectric constant within existing process flows. However, dopant selection is still largely empirical due to the coupled interplay among thermodynamic stability, electronic insulation, and dielectric response. Here, we present a high-throughput computational framework integrating special quasi-random structures (SQS), machine-learning potentials (SevenNet), and graph neural networks (ALIGNN) to systematically evaluate doped-HfO2 compositions across three dopants (Al, Si, Y) and two technologically relevant polymorphs (monoclinic and orthorhombic). Our analysis uncovers a fundamental design principle: formation energy, band gap, and dielectric constant are decoupled parameters requiring application-specific prioritization rather than simultaneous optimization. Yttrium achieves the lowest formation energy (-3.763 eV/atom) and favors orthorhombic phase stabilization at process-compatible thermal budgets; silicon preserves near-pristine band gaps (around 5.72 eV) critical for suppressing leakage in gate dielectric applications; and aluminum enables concentration-tunable band gap widening (5.6-5.9 eV) suited for voltage scaling. Validation against experimental literature and density functional theory (DFT) confirms quantitative accuracy (0.02 eV band gap error for Si-doping, mean absolute error less than 0.001 eV/atom formation energy). This framework provides rational, property-decoupled guidance for dopant engineering in HfO2-based dielectrics and related high-k oxide systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个高通量计算框架，结合特殊准随机结构(SQS)、机器学习势(SevenNet)和图神经网络(ALIGNN)，系统评估了Al、Si、Y三种掺杂剂对HfO2单斜相和正交相的性能影响，发现形成能、带隙和介电常数是解耦的参数，需要根据应用场景分别优化。Y掺杂获得最低形成能并稳定正交相，Si掺杂保持近本征带隙(约5.72 eV)，Al掺杂可实现带隙可调(5.6-5.9 eV)。实验结果与DFT验证显示定量精度高。
AI.motivation: HfO2是现代硅技术中的关键高k介电材料，掺杂是工程化其带隙和介电常数的主要手段，但掺杂剂选择在很大程度上仍依赖经验，因为热力学稳定性、电子绝缘性和介电响应之间存在耦合相互作用，缺乏系统性的理论指导。
AI.method: 构建了一个高通量计算框架，集成三种技术：(1)特殊准随机结构(SQS)用于生成掺杂构型；(2)机器学习势(SevenNet)用于高效计算；(3)图神经网络(ALIGNN)用于性质预测。系统评估了Al、Si、Y三种掺杂剂在单斜相和正交相两种多晶型中的性能。
AI.result: 发现形成能、带隙和介电常数是解耦参数，需按应用优先级选择：Y掺杂形成能最低(-3.763 eV/atom)且有利于正交相稳定；Si掺杂保持近本征带隙(约5.72 eV)，适合栅极介电应用以抑制泄漏；Al掺杂实现浓度可调的带隙拓宽(5.6-5.9 eV)，适合电压缩放。经实验文献和DFT验证，Si掺杂带隙误差仅0.02 eV，形成能MAE小于0.001 eV/atom。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为HfO2基介电材料及相关高k氧化物体系的掺杂工程提供了理性、性质解耦的设计指导，克服了传统的经验性掺杂选择方法，实现了掺杂剂筛选的定量化与系统化。

title: Lectures on ultrathin film ferromagnetism
summary: In these Lecture Notes we review some of the fundamental principles that have emerged from research on the ferromagnetism of ultrathin films consisting of 3d transition-metal overlayers. Their growth is often layer-by-layer. This growth mode produces quantum wells along the vertical direction that profoundly impact any physical property of the materials. In addition, the vertical confinement establishes spin ensembles that extend to macroscopic distances along the in-plane directions and are finite along the vertical (perpendicular) direction, i.e. they are two-dimensional. Accordingly, they display ground state properties that originate from the two-dimensionality, such as ``dead'' magnetic layers or ``enhanced magnetic moments'', an oscillatory interlayer magnetic coupling and an anomalous perpendicular versus in-plane magnetic anisotropy that produces, in some specific situations, a perpendicular collective orientation of the spins. At finite temperatures, ferromagnetic order is observed to persist and an analysis of the magnetic order of ultrathin films in terms of the renormalization group provides a suitable framework for explaining this observation. The ferromagnetic order is lost at a phase transition which follows closely the two-dimensional Ising universality class, as shown by an accurate analysis of data in the vicinity of the critical point. The perpendicular spin orientation is often observed to turn in-plane by a reorientation phase transition which is also properly described by a renormalization group argument. Finally, the perpendicular spin orientation introduces topological excitations of the ferromagnetic order, consisting of stripes of reversed perpendicular spin direction. The stripe order undergoes a phase transition to the paramagnetic state that is not yet completely understood.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了超薄3d过渡金属薄膜铁磁性的基本原理，涵盖量子阱导致的垂直约束效应、二维自旋系统的基态特性（死磁层、增强磁矩、振荡层间耦合、垂直磁各向异性）、有限温度下的铁磁有序及重整化群分析、二维Ising临界行为、再取向相变以及条纹拓扑激发等核心议题。
AI.motivation: 超薄3d过渡金属薄膜的铁磁性涉及复杂而丰富的物理现象，包括二维性带来的独特基态性质、层间耦合、磁各向异性以及临界行为。作者旨在系统回顾该领域已建立的基本原理，为理解二维磁性系统提供统一的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用理论研究与实验数据分析相结合的方法：基于层状生长形成的量子阱约束建立二维自旋体系模型，运用重整化群理论分析有限温度下的铁磁有序和再取向相变，并通过临界点附近的高精度数据拟合验证二维Ising普适类行为。
AI.result: 超薄膜在有限温度下可保持铁磁序，相变遵循二维Ising普适类；垂直自旋取向可通过再取向相变转为面内取向；垂直取向引入的反向条纹拓扑激发通往顺磁态的相变机制尚未完全明确。
AI.conclusion: 重整化群方法为理解超薄膜二维磁性提供了一个有效的理论框架，能够解释有限温度铁磁序的持久性、临界普适行为以及自旋再取向相变，但条纹拓扑激发的相变性质仍需进一步研究。

title: Advancing in situ hydrogen embrittlement studies through an integrated charging cell for SEM micromechanical testing
summary: A comprehensive understanding of hydrogen-deformation interactions at the microscale is essential for revealing hydrogen embrittlement mechanisms. In situ micromechanics with simultaneous hydrogen (H-) charging has therefore gained traction in recent times. In the present study, we aim to address the drawbacks of current in situ H-charging setups by developing a more robust 3-electrode-based back-side charging system for a scanning electron microscope to perform various micromechanical tests. The development of the novel setup is discussed and demonstrated through micropillar compression of an Fe-25Cr single crystal (110) during H-charging. H has increased the yield strength and the apparent strain-hardening rate. H activates multiple slip systems and enhances dislocation density and entanglement, leading to pronounced forest hardening as revealed by electron microscopy. Estimation of activation volume from strain-rate jump tests indicates that the deformation is controlled by the solute drag effect on kink mobility and dislocation forest hardening.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一种基于三电极体系的背面充氢系统，用于扫描电子显微镜内的原位微力学测试，并通过Fe-25Cr单晶(110)微柱压缩实验证明其可行性，揭示氢通过激活多滑移系、增强位错密度和缠结来提升屈服强度和应变硬化率，变形由溶质拖曳效应和位错林强化控制。
AI.motivation: 理解微观尺度下氢-变形相互作用对揭示氢脆机制至关重要，但现有的原位充氢装置存在缺陷，需要开发更稳健的充氢系统以支持原位微力学测试。
AI.method: 开发了一种基于三电极的背面充氢系统，集成于扫描电子显微镜中；通过Fe-25Cr单晶(110)微柱压缩实验进行验证，并结合应变速率跳变实验和电子显微分析评估位错结构和激活体积。
AI.result: 氢显著提高了屈服强度和表观应变硬化率；氢激活了多个滑移系，增加了位错密度和缠结程度，产生了明显的林强化效应；激活体积估算表明变形受溶质拖曳效应（影响扭结迁移率）和位错林强化共同控制。
AI.conclusion: 新开发的三电极背面充氢系统能够稳健地实现SEM内的原位微力学测试，证实了氢通过促进位错增殖和增强林强化来影响Fe-Cr合金的塑性变形行为。

title: Electron transport in a 1.6~nm-thick double-gated (100) silicon nanosheet: A theoretical study accounting for phonon confinement and remote-phonon scattering
summary: We study theoretically electron transport in an top-and bottom-gated (100) 1.6 nm-thin silicon nanosheet with SiO2/HfO2 gate stacks, focusing on the intrinsic physical processes that affect transport: the confinement of phonons and the presence of interface hybrid plasmon-phonon excitations (IPPs or `remote phonons'). The band structure is calculated using local empirical pseudopotentials; an approximated elastic continuum model is used to consider the confinement of acoustic phonons; the dielectric continuum limit is used to deal with the IPPs. We find that the electron mobility is affected significantly by the boundary conditions chosen to deal with phonon confinement. The more realistic assumption of phonons clamped at the SiO2/HfO2 interfaces and optical phonons at the Si/SiO2 interfaces results in a room temperature mobility much smaller than what is obtained using the common assumption of bulk phonons in the elastic, high-temperature approximation. We also find that, as a result of the complicated structure of the primed subbands, the high-field saturated velocity is significantly lower than its bulk value, as it had been measured in the past in the case of Si inversion layers but never explained theoretically. Finally, we find that IPP scattering does depress the low-field mobility but to a small extent, thanks to the presence of the interfacial SiO2 layers and to the proximity of the metal gates. Moreover, by keeping electrons `cooler', IPP scattering results in a higher saturated velocity. Therefore, the presence of high-kappa materials in the gate-insulator stacks should not affect negatively the performance of field effect transistors based on Si nanosheets.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上研究了顶栅和底栅(100)1.6nm超薄硅纳米片中的电子输运特性，重点分析了声子限制和界面混合等离激元-声子激发(IPP)对输运的内在物理影响。发现声子边界条件对电子迁移率影响显著，而IPP散射对低场迁移率的抑制程度有限，且能使电子"更冷"从而提高饱和速度，因此高k栅介质材料不会对硅纳米片场效应晶体管的性能产生负面影响。
AI.motivation: 随着硅基器件尺寸不断缩小至纳米片尺度，器件性能受到量子限制效应、声子限制以及高k栅介质引入的远程声子散射等内在物理过程的显著影响。理解这些物理机制对评估和优化超薄硅纳米片场效应晶体管的性能至关重要。
AI.method: 采用局部经验赝势方法计算能带结构；利用近似弹性连续介质模型处理声子限制；采用介电连续极限处理IPP；研究不同边界条件（钳位/非钳位）对声子散射的影响，并分析高场饱和速度和低场迁移率。
AI.result: 1) 声子边界条件对电子迁移率影响显著，钳位边界条件得到的室温迁移率远小于块体声子假设；2) 由于有撇次能带的复杂结构，高场饱和速度显著低于块体值，解释了此前在Si反型层中观测到但未能理论解释的现象；3) IPP散射对低场迁移率的抑制程度较小，且通过保持电子"更冷"反而提高饱和速度；4) 高k材料的存在不会对Si纳米片FET性能产生负面影响。
AI.conclusion: 高k栅介质堆叠不会负面影响基于硅纳米片的场效应晶体管性能：SiO2界面层和金属栅极的邻近性减弱了IPP散射的影响，且IPP散射通过降低电子温度提高了饱和速度。合理的声子边界条件选择对于准确预测超薄硅纳米片中的载流子输运至关重要。

title: Lithography-free patterning of SrTiO$_3$-based two-dimensional electron gases using direct atomic layer processing
summary: We present a scalable and lithography-free strategy for the realization of a two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) in TiO$_2$-patterned SrTiO$_3$ (100) via Al deposition using magnetron sputtering. A 15 nm thick TiO$_2$ layer, deposited by direct atomic layer processing, is employed to spatially define the conducting regions, enabling direct transport measurements without post-growth microfabrication. Upon Al deposition, an insulating AlO$_x$ overlayer is formed, and the region lacking the TiO$_2$ pattern leads to the creation of oxygen vacancies in SrTiO$_3$. These oxygen vacancies act as electron donors, populating the Ti 3$d$ conduction bands and giving rise to a confined 2DEG at the interface. Magneto-transport measurements reveal a sheet carrier density on the order of $\approx5-7\times10^{13}$ cm$^{-2}$, comparable to values typically achieved in pulsed laser deposition-grown SrTiO$_3$-based heterostructures, along with effective electrostatic tunability. This work demonstrates a simple, cost-effective, and industry-compatible route for engineering oxide 2DEGs, providing a versatile platform for scalable device fabrication and interfacial transport studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可扩展且无需光刻的方法，通过在SrTiO3(100)上沉积Al来制备二维电子气(2DEG)。利用15nm厚的TiO2图案层来空间定义导电区域，Al沉积后形成绝缘AlOx层，未覆盖TiO2的区域产生氧空位作为电子施主，在界面处形成受限的2DEG。磁输运测量显示载流子密度约为5-7×10¹³ cm⁻²，并具有有效的静电可调性。
AI.motivation: 传统的氧化物2DEG制备通常依赖脉冲激光沉积(PLD)等复杂工艺和光刻微加工步骤，成本高且难以工业规模化。作者希望开发一种简单、经济且与工业兼容的方法来工程化氧化物二维电子气，为可扩展器件制造和界面输运研究提供通用平台。
AI.method: 采用磁控溅射在TiO2图案化的SrTiO3(100)衬底上沉积Al。首先通过直接原子层处理沉积15nm厚TiO2层来空间定义导电区域，然后沉积Al形成绝缘AlOx覆盖层。未覆盖TiO2图案的区域通过Al沉积在SrTiO3中产生氧空位，这些氧空位作为电子施主填充Ti 3d导带，在界面处形成受限的2DEG。
AI.result: 磁输运测量显示片载流子密度约为5-7×10¹³ cm⁻²，与脉冲激光沉积生长的SrTiO3异质结中获得的典型值相当，并表现出有效的静电可调性。该方法无需生长后进行微加工即可直接进行输运测量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了一种简单、经济且与工业兼容的氧化物2DEG工程化路线，为可扩展器件制造和界面输运研究提供了多功能平台，有望推动氧化物电子学向实际应用方向发展。

title: Second-Chern Bounds in Non-Abelian Quantum Geometry
summary: We study the quantum geometry of doubly degenerate energy levels in a four-dimensional parameter space. For degenerate pairs with $SU(2)$ gauge structures, the quantum geometry obeys $\big(\textrm{tr } g\big)^2/16\geq\sqrt{\det g}\geq |\textrm{Tr}(F\wedge F)|/12$. The first inequality characterizes the anisotropy in the metric. The second determinant inequality measures the self-duality of the curvature under Hodge star operation and the inter-level processes that do not close under the three $SU(2)$ rotations of the doubly degenerate levels. The saturation of the determinant bound induces a quaternion Kähler structure on the four-dimensional parameter space, analogous to the complex structure induced by the ideal-band condition in two-dimensional Chern insulators. As examples, four-band Dirac Hamiltonians automatically saturate the determinant bound and possess a topological zero in $\textrm{Tr}(F\wedge F)$. We discuss the comparison to degenerate pairs with $U(2)$ gauge structures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了四维参数空间中双重简并能级的量子几何性质。对于具有 SU(2) 规范结构的简并配对，量子几何满足 (tr g)²/16 ≥ √det g ≥ |Tr(F∧F)|/12 的不等式链，其中第一个不等式刻画度量的各向异性，第二个行列式不等式度量曲率在霍奇星操作下的自对偶性以及不闭合于三个 SU(2) 旋转的能级间过程。行列式界限的饱和在四维参数空间上诱导出四元数 Kähler 结构，类似于二维 Chern 绝缘体中理想带条件所诱导的复结构。四带 Dirac Hamiltonian 自动饱和行列式界限并具有 Tr(F∧F) 的拓扑零点。文章还讨论了与 U(2) 规范结构简并配对的比较。
AI.motivation: 从二维 Chern 绝缘体中的理想带条件（诱导复结构）推广到四维参数空间中的双重简并能级，探索量子几何不等式链及其饱和条件如何诱导四元数 Kähler 结构，从而建立更高维度的拓扑量子几何理论框架。
AI.method: 通过推导双重简并能级（SU(2) 规范结构）的量子几何张量 g 和曲率 F，证明不等式链 (tr g)²/16 ≥ √det g ≥ |Tr(F∧F)|/12。分析两个不等式的物理含义：前者刻画度量各向异性，后者衡量曲率自对偶性。研究行列式界限饱和条件与四元数 Kähler 结构的关系，并以四带 Dirac Hamiltonian 作为具体实例验证。
AI.result: 建立了四维参数空间中 SU(2) 简并能级的量子几何不等式链；证明第二个不等式（行列式界限）的饱和等价于诱导四元数 Kähler 结构；发现四带 Dirac Hamiltonian 自动饱和行列式界限且 Tr(F∧F) 具有拓扑零点；并与 U(2) 规范结构的情形进行了对比。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将二维 Chern 绝缘体理想带条件的思想推广到四维空间，建立了量子几何与四元数 Kähler 结构之间的深刻联系，为理解高维简并能级的拓扑与几何性质提供了新框架。

title: Exact solution for stationary states of a closed memristor with mobile charged vacancies
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, bilingual: English (edited machine translation), Russian (primary)
summary: A nonlinear model of a memristor based on charged mobile vacancies is considered taking into account the electrostatic interaction between them. This interaction significantly affects the stationary (limiting) vacancy distributions formed under the action of the electric current flowing through the memristor, for which analytical expressions are obtained in this work. Between the regions with reduced and increased vacancy concentrations, an intermediate electrically neutral region is formed due to the electrostatic interaction. Interestingly, the limiting resistances in the ``on'' and ``off'' states of such a memristor do not depend on the strength of the electrostatic interaction, at least in the leading first order in the vacancy concentration.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于带电移动空位的忆阻器非线性模型，考虑了空位之间的静电相互作用。研究表明这种相互作用显著影响电流作用下形成的稳态（极限）空位分布，并获得了这些分布的解析表达式。静电相互作用会在空位浓度降低和升高的区域之间形成电中性中间区域。有趣的是，忆阻器"开"和"关"状态的极限电阻至少在空位浓度的一阶主导项上不依赖于静电相互作用的强度。
AI.motivation: 理解忆阻器中带电空位的静电相互作用如何影响其稳态空位分布和极限电阻特性，从而揭示忆阻器工作机制中尚未被充分研究的物理效应。
AI.method: 建立考虑静电相互作用的带电移动空位非线性忆阻器模型，通过解析推导获得电流作用下稳态（极限）空位分布的解析表达式，并分析静电相互作用对分布形态和极限电阻的影响。
AI.result: 静电相互作用显著改变空位的稳态分布，在空位浓度降低区与升高区之间形成电中性中间区域；但"开"和"关"状态的极限电阻在空位浓度一阶主导项上不依赖于静电相互作用强度。
AI.conclusion: 静电相互作用对忆阻器内部空位分布形态有重要影响，但忆阻器的极限电阻特性（至少在主导阶）对静电相互作用具有鲁棒性，这为忆阻器器件的稳定设计提供了理论依据。

title: Optically Tunable Threshold Switching and Thermally Activated Transport in Planar Ag/MAPbI$_3$ Thin Single-Crystal Devices
summary: Halide perovskites have enabled major advances in optoelectronics, extending well beyond photovoltaics. Their mixed ionic-electronic conduction, once regarded as detrimental to device stability, is increasingly viewed as a functional degree of freedom for memory and neuromorphic-inspired devices, especially when coupled to external stimuli such as light. Specifically, single crystals are attractive models because they suppress grain-boundary effects and microstructural disorder that can mask intrinsic transport and interfacial mechanisms in polycrystalline films. Here, we report the growth of thin methylammonium lead iodide (MAPbI$_3$) single crystals by a space-confined method and their integration into planar two-terminal devices with directly deposited Ag contacts. At room temperature, the devices exhibit ultra-low dark currents ($10^{-13}-10^{-12}$ A) and negligible hysteresis in the dark. Under illumination, the current increases due to photogeneration and the I-V characteristics develop a pronounced polarity-dependent hysteresis and a threshold-like transition between two conductance states. Temperature-dependent dark measurements (300-400 K) show thermionically activated, contact-influenced transport and a weakly varying normalized hysteresis metric. Together with the back-to-back Schottky-diode analysis and control devices using more inert contact materials, these results support a transport model in which Ag/perovskite interfaces play a central role and the hysteretic response is influenced by coupled interfacial and ionic processes.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了通过空间限制法生长甲基铵铅碘（MAPbI₃）薄单晶，并集成到带有Ag接触的平面两端器件中。室温黑暗下器件表现出超低暗电流（10⁻¹³-10⁻¹² A）和可忽略的迟滞；光照下电流因光生载流子增加，I-V特性出现明显的极性依赖迟滞和两种电导态间的阈值转变。温度相关黑暗测量（300-400 K）结合背靠背肖特基二极管分析和惰性接触材料对照组，支持Ag/钙钛矿界面在输运中起核心作用、迟滞响应受耦合的界面和离子过程影响的输运模型。
AI.motivation: 卤化物钙钛矿的混合离子-电子导电性曾被视作器件稳定性的威胁，但如今被视为实现存储和神经形态器件的功能自由度。单晶作为理想模型体系可抑制多晶薄膜中的晶界效应和微观结构无序，从而揭示本征输运和界面机制。
AI.method: 采用空间限制法生长MAPbI₃薄单晶，集成到平面两端器件中并直接沉积Ag接触。通过室温光照下的I-V特性测量观察迟滞和双电导态转变；通过300-400 K温度相关的暗态测量分析热离子激活输运；结合背靠背肖特基二极管模型分析和惰性接触材料的对照器件实验来验证输运模型。
AI.result: 室温暗态下器件具有超低暗电流（10⁻¹³-10⁻¹² A）且迟滞可忽略；光照下出现极性依赖迟滞和阈值型双电导态转变。暗态温度测量显示热离子激活的接触影响输运，归一化迟滞指标变化微弱。Ag/钙钛矿界面在输运中起核心作用，迟滞受耦合界面与离子过程影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明Ag/钙钛矿界面与离子过程耦合是迟滞响应的关键机制，为利用卤化物钙钛矿单晶的混合导电性开发面向存储和神经形态应用的光响应器件提供了物理基础。

title: Wormhole Geometry from a Magnetic Vortex
summary: Strong coupling to a magnetic texture makes an electron propagate through an emergent curved space. We show that an elementary vortex realizes the exterior spatial geometry of an Ellis wormhole: an ultrastatic throat with radius fixed by the topological charge and Hund exchange, cut off at short distances by the microscopic core. Two separable signatures follow directly: the electron deflection collapses onto a single Ellis curve governed by the vortex winding and exchange coupling, while the spin Berry phase produces a half-flux Aharonov--Bohm response switched on and off by winding parity. The same metric can be emulated in a designer honeycomb lattice, where the valley-symmetrized wave-packet response follows the predicted exterior geodesic. These signatures are accessible through real-space electron deflection and scattering, providing experimentally distinct probes of the emergent geometry and Berry flux. The magnetic vortex thus turns a topological defect into a tunable curved-space lens for electrons in quantum materials and designer lattices.

AI.tldr: 本文发现磁性涡旋（magnetic vortex）可使电子在涌现的弯曲空间中传播，其外部空间几何等价于Ellis虫洞（一种超静态喉道，半径由拓扑荷和Hund交换决定）。电子偏转统一塌缩到一条Ellis曲线，且自旋Berry相位产生由缠绕奇偶性开关的半通量Aharonov-Bohm响应。该度规可在设计的蜂巢晶格中复现，为量子材料和设计晶格提供了可实验探测的涌现几何与Berry通量探针。
AI.motivation: 探索磁性纹理（magnetic texture）如何通过强耦合使电子在涌现的弯曲空间中传播，并寻找这种涌现几何的可观测特征。将拓扑缺陷（磁性涡旋）与广义相对论中的虫洞几何联系起来，希望提供可实验验证的量子材料中的涌现时空探针。
AI.method: 理论分析磁性涡旋中电子在涌现弯曲空间中的传播：1) 证明基本涡旋实现Ellis虫洞的外部空间几何，其喉道半径由拓扑荷和Hund交换固定，短距离由微观核心截断；2) 推导两个可分离的签名：电子偏转塌缩为单一Ellis曲线（由涡旋缠绕和交换耦合控制），以及自旋Berry相位产生半通量Aharonov-Bohm响应（由缠绕奇偶性开关）；3) 在设计的蜂巢晶格中仿真相同度规，验证谷对称波包响应遵循预测的外部测地线。
AI.result: 磁性涡旋成功实现了Ellis虫洞的外部空间几何，产生了两个独特的可观测签名：统一的Ellis偏转曲线和由缠绕奇偶性控制的半通量Aharonov-Bohm响应。该涌现度规可在设计的蜂巢晶格中复现，并通过实空间电子偏转和散射实验进行验证。
AI.conclusion: 磁性涡旋将拓扑缺陷转化为量子材料和设计晶格中可调谐的弯曲空间电子透镜，为实验探测涌现几何和Berry通量提供了独特且可区分的探针。

title: Strain-controlled sign reversal of the anomalous Hall effect in Ru/[Co/Ni]$_N$ multilayers
summary: The anomalous Hall effect (AHE) is a hallmark transport phenomenon in ferromagnets arising from relativistic spin-orbit interaction. Here, we report an unexpected sign reversal of the AHE in Ru/[Co/Ni]$_N$ multilayers controlled by the stacking sequence of the Ru layer. When Ru is placed beneath, rather than atop, the Co/Ni multilayers, the anomalous Hall signal switches from positive to negative. By systematically varying the multilayer repeat number N and combining transport measurements with first-principles calculations, we show that this reversal originates from in-plane tensile strain imposed by the Ru underlayer, which reshapes the electronic structure and redistributes Berry curvature near the Fermi level. Our findings establish interfacial strain as an effective knob for tuning Berry-curvature-driven transport and suggest a pathway toward strain-controlled topological transport phenomena in magnetic multilayers.

title: Emergent gauge flux and spin ordering in magnetized triangular spin liquids: Applications to Hofstadter-Hubbard model
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures. To appear in Physical Review Letters
summary: Motivated by recent progress in moiré superlattices and spin-1/2 triangular-lattice antiferromagnets, we study how orbital magnetic flux and Zeeman coupling compete or cooperate in generating internal U(1) gauge flux in a triangular spin liquid. We show that orbital flux favors a chiral spin liquid with staggered internal flux, whereas Zeeman coupling destabilizes the spinon Fermi-pocket state toward a Landau-level state with spontaneous uniform internal flux and conical spin order. We demonstrate this mechanism in a spin-$1/2$ $J_1$-$J_2$-$J_χ$ model, and further identify thermal Hall and magnetic signatures that distinguish these regimes, with potential applications to moiré Hofstadter-Hubbard systems and triangular-lattice antiferromagnets.

title: Magneto-optical magnetoelectric voltage sensor
summary: Applications in high-voltage and electromagnetically harsh environments require reliable galvanically isolated voltage sensing, which can be achieved using optical readout. While established optical voltage sensors rely on electro-optic effects or piezoelectric strain with direct optical detection, strain-mediated magnetoelectric coupling combined with magneto-optical readout offers an alternative voltage sensing principle that remains largely unexplored. Here, such a sensor based on a bismuth-substituted yttrium iron garnet magneto-optical indicator film mechanically coupled to a piezoelectric actuator is presented. Voltage induced stress results in changes of the out-of-plane magnetization via magnetoelastic coupling which is detected through magneto-optical Faraday rotation. A critical state of the domain structure is set via an applied bias field, in which voltage-induced nucleation and domain-wall motion dominates the response. In this high sensitivity regime, both AC and DC voltage readout modes are demonstrated, based on either voltage-driven magnetization reversal or voltage-induced modifications of the magnetization loop shape. Equivalent voltage noise densities in the millivolt per root hertz range are achieved. The results establish strain-mediated magneto-optical voltage sensing as a distinct approach to optically isolated voltage measurement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并演示了一种基于应变介导磁电耦合与磁光读出的新型光隔离电压传感器，利用钇铁石榴石磁光指示薄膜与压电致动器的机械耦合，通过法拉第旋转检测电压引起的磁化变化，实现了交流/直流电压读出，等效电压噪声密度达到毫伏每根赫兹量级。

title: Resonant Raman signatures of bright and momentum-dark exciton coupled by intervalley phonon scattering in monolayer WSe2
summary: Exciton-phonon coupling in atomically thin transition metal dichalcogenides governs key processes such as exciton thermalization and intervalley scattering and remains challenging to access directly by optical spectroscopy. Here, we employ resonance Raman spectroscopy at cryogenic temperatures to probe exciton-phonon coupling in hBN-encapsulated WSe_2 monolayers. Tuning the excitation laser across the bright exciton X_KK resonance, we observe rich Raman spectra and focus on the resonance profile of the degenerate A_1'/E' optical phonon mode. The profile exhibits two asymmetric resonance peaks whose energetic separation significantly exceeds the phonon energy - a feature that cannot be explained by first-order Raman scattering alone. We demonstrate that this discrepancy is resolved by including third-order Raman scattering, in which intervalley scattering enabled by a finite-momentum phonon couples the bright exciton X_KK to a momentum-dark exciton X_d. Fitting the experimental resonance profiles of two independent samples with a model comprising coherent first- and third-order scattering yields consistent exciton energies and linewidths, with a momentum-dark exciton X_d approximately 45meV to 55meV below the bright exciton X_KK. The results indicate efficient bright-to-dark exciton coupling. Our findings provide a microscopic framework for understanding the anomalously bright emission spectra of WSe_2 monolayers despite its spin-forbidden lowest exciton transition and highlight the role of momentum-dark excitons in resonant light-matter interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文利用低温共振拉曼光谱研究了hBN封装的WSe₂单层中激子-声子耦合。通过调节激发激光能量跨越亮激子X_KK共振，发现A_1'/E'光学声子模式出现两个不对称共振峰，其能级间距远超声子能量。作者证明这需要引入三阶拉曼散射来解释：有限动量声子介导的谷间散射将亮激子X_KK与动量暗激子X_d耦合。模型拟合显示动量暗激子位于亮激子下方约45-55 meV，揭示了高效的亮-暗激子耦合机制。

title: Electronic structure, band offset, and interface electron population of the LaInO$_3$/BaSnO$_3$ system
summary: Perovskite oxides and their heterostructures exhibit a wide range of functional properties. Among these materials, BaSnO$_3$/LaInO$_3$ heterostructures form high-mobility two-dimensional electron gases (2DEGs) at their interfaces. In particular, room-temperature electron mobilities exceeding 100~cm$^2$/Vs were enabled by recent advances in thin-film growth. This work presents a combined experimental and theoretical study of the electronic structure of BaSnO$_3$, LaInO$_3$, and BaSnO$_3$/LaInO$_3$ heterostructures with varying LaInO$_3$ overlayer thicknesses. Soft and hard X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (SXPS and HAXPES) measurements are combined with densities of states (DOS) derived from hybrid density functional theory (DFT) calculations. The analysis of core, semi-core, and valence states allows to arrive at a comprehensive understanding of the chemical bonding and electronic structure in the parent oxides as well as the formed heterostructures. For the BaSnO$_3$/LaInO$_3$ heterostructure, the band offset and population of 2DEG states at the interface is directly probed using HAXPES.

AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了BaSnO₃/LaInO₃体系电子结构的综合实验与理论认识，揭示了界面处的能带偏移和2DEG态占据特性，为该类高迁移率二维电子气材料的进一步研究与应用奠定了坚实基础。

title: Energy-Dependent Dechanneling in Cu: Insights from Monte Carlo Channeling Simulations
summary: Ion channeling and backscattering techniques are powerful tools for studying crystal lattice disorders and defect structures in crystalline materials. However, the accurate interpretation of channeling phenomena necessitates the utilization of simulation models that account for the intricate interactions between point defects, dislocations, and extended defect clusters. The present paper introduces a Monte Carlo method that reproduces experimental spectra over a wide range of analyzing beam energies and enables quantitative identification of defect types and distributions. The simulations reveal characteristic energy dependencies that distinguish point defects from extended defects, offering a novel perspective on disturbances caused, for example, by ion implantation in metals and semiconductors. To this end, the McChasy code has been developed as a flexible and accessible tool for scientists, enabling the modeling of various crystal systems, including complex semiconductors, multilayer epitaxial films, and oxide crystals. The program's integration of experimental data on ion channeling with defect modeling establishes a robust framework for defect analysis in materials science. The present article expounds upon the simulation capabilities of the program by reproducing the characteristic "elbows" in channeling spectra that were previously observed in experiments conducted on Cu crystals.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种基于蒙特卡洛方法的离子沟道模拟程序McChasy，该程序能够在广泛的分析束能量范围内重现实验光谱，并定量识别缺陷类型和分布。通过模拟揭示了区分点缺陷与扩展缺陷的特征能量依赖关系，成功复现了铜晶体沟道谱中先前实验观察到的特征"肘部"结构。

title: Thermoelastic Harvesting Outperforming Thermoelectric Generators Below 100 °C
summary: Low-grade waste heat below 100 degC is one of the largest untapped opportunities in solid-state energy conversion. Three ferroic routes are candidates for recovering this resource: thermomagnetic, pyroelectric, and thermoelastic harvesters. The last has remained the most unexplored, despite decades of progress on the underlying NiTi shape-memory alloy wires. Three system-design changes close this gap: a protagonist-antagonist architecture that recovers the energy for prestraining, a continuously tunable prestrain mechanism that sets the force-strain balance, and transversal water flow that decouples cycle frequency from wire length. The resulting harvester delivers a directly measured power density of 366 mW/cm^3 with respect to the active material, about 1.7 times the next-best thermoelastic device, ahead of every reported thermomagnetic and pyroelectric generator, and outperforming the best thermoelectric generators in this temperature range also with respect to power per material cost. The system maps the parameter space directly through force and displacement measurements, without using material-property estimates, giving a quantitative picture of how the alloy responds while the device is doing work.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种利用NiTi形状记忆合金丝回收低于100°C低品位废热的弹性热（thermoelastic）能量收集器。通过三种系统设计创新——主-对抗体（protagonist-antagonist）架构、连续可调预应变机制和横向水流设计——实现了366 mW/cm³的功率密度，比次优弹性热装置高约1.7倍，超越了所有已报道的热磁和热电（pyroelectric）发电机，在该温度范围内甚至在功率/材料成本方面优于最佳热电（thermoelectric）发电机。

AI.result: 该收集器实现直接测量的功率密度为366 mW/cm³（相对于活性材料），是次优弹性热装置的约1.7倍，超越了所有已报道的热磁和热电（pyroelectric）发电机，并在该温度范围内以功率/材料成本计优于最佳热电（thermoelectric）发电机。系统直接通过力和位移测量映射参数空间，无需材料属性估算。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过创新的系统架构设计大幅提升了弹性热能量收集的性能，使其在该温度范围内超越其他铁性路线和热电方案，为低品位废热回收提供了有效的固态能量转换途径。系统的直接测量方法也提供了合金在实际做功过程中的定量响应图景。

title: Beam Routing through Excitons in Transition Metal Dichalcogenide Monolayers
summary: Routing light at the nanoscale typically relies on nanostructured surfaces to imprint directionality on the emission. Using low-temperature, angle-resolved cathodoluminescence spectroscopy, we show that the intrinsic excitonic transitions of a semiconductor can themselves produce routed emission. We probe monolayers of WSe$_2$, MoSe$_2$, and MoTe$_2$ and resolve the excitonic species of monolayer WSe$_2$ -- the bright exciton, the trion, and the spin-forbidden dark exciton -- through their distinct angular emission profiles. While the in-plane transition dipoles of the bright exciton and trion radiate predominantly toward the surface normal, the out-of-plane dipole of the dark exciton, inaccessible under normal-incidence optical excitation, produces a directional emission channel at large angles. We further tune the balance between neutral and charged exciton emission through the local dielectric environment. Our results establish dark excitons in TMD monolayers as a platform for directional light emission in compact photonic architectures without additional nanostructuring.

AI.tldr: 本文通过低温角分辨阴极发光光谱，展示了半导体中固有的激子跃迁本身即可产生定向发射，无需额外纳米结构。研究人员在WSe₂、MoSe₂和MoTe₂单层中分辨了亮激子、三激子和自旋禁戒暗激子，发现暗激子的面外偶极子在特定角度产生定向发射通道，确立了TMD单层暗激子作为紧凑光子结构中无需纳米结构化的定向光发射平台。
AI.motivation: 纳米尺度的光路由通常依赖纳米结构表面来赋予发射方向性，这增加了器件复杂性和制造难度。研究人员希望探索是否可以利用半导体本身的固有激子跃迁特性来实现定向发射，从而简化器件结构并开辟新的物理机制。
AI.method: 采用低温角分辨阴极发光光谱技术，对WSe₂、MoSe₂和MoTe₂单层进行探测。通过解析不同激子物种（亮激子、三激子、自旋禁戒暗激子）的角分辨发射图谱，分析面内和面外跃迁偶极子的辐射方向特性，并通过调控局部介电环境来调节中性/带电激子发射平衡。
AI.result: 发现WSe₂单层中的亮激子和三激子的面内跃迁偶极子主要向表面法线方向辐射，而暗激子的面外偶极子在大角度产生定向发射通道。通过局部介电环境调控可以调节中性激子与带电激子之间的发射平衡。
AI.conclusion: TMD单层的暗激子可作为无需额外纳米结构化的定向光发射平台，为紧凑光子架构中的方向性光源提供了一种新的本征物理机制。

title: The electrical transport of intrinsic two-dimensional ferroelectric metal PtBi2
summary: Breaking the conventional stereotype that ferroelectrics are necessarily insulating, two-dimensional (2D) ferroelectric metals combine seemingly incompatible switchable electric polarization and metallic conductivity, providing a fertile ground for the discovery of novel electrical transport phenomena and the development of innovative electronic devices. Using the semiclassical Boltzmann equation and first-principles calculations, we systematically investigate the linear and nonlinear transport responses of the intrinsic 2D ferroelectric metal \ch{PtBi2} to an applied electric field. Our \textit{ab initio} molecular dynamics simulations reveal that it possesses a high Curie temperature reaching $800~\text{K}$. We propose that the crystal structure of its high-temperature paraelectric phase can be explicitly distinguished through simple measurements of the in-plane electrical conductivity. Quantitative calculations of the Edelstein effect and the intrinsic spin Hall effect demonstrate a sizable charge-to-spin conversion efficiency, highlighting its potential in spintronics. We also find that a Berry curvature dipole-induced nonlinear Hall effect emerges in uniaxially strained \ch{PtBi2}. Furthermore, we highlight the unique advantages of 2D ferroelectric metals in gate-controlled transport applications. Based on the domain wall scattering mechanism, we conceptually design a novel ferroelectric metal field-effect transistor (FEM-FET) capable of nonvolatile switching between high-resistance and low-resistance states under a gate voltage. Our work not only unveils the rich transport physics in 2D ferroelectric metals but also provides valuable insights into the design of next-generation nonvolatile memory and spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了二维铁电金属PtBi₂的电输运性质，发现其居里温度高达800 K，并通过玻尔兹曼方程和第一性原理计算揭示了线性与非线性输运响应、Edelstein效应、自旋霍尔效应及Berry曲率偶极子诱导的非线性霍尔效应，还基于畴壁散射机制设计了新型铁电金属场效应晶体管（FEM-FET）。
AI.motivation: 打破铁电体必然是绝缘体的传统观念，二维铁电金属将可切换电极化与金属导电性结合，有望发现新颖电输运现象并推动创新电子器件的发展。作者旨在系统揭示这一类新奇材料中的输运物理及其器件应用潜力。
AI.method: 使用半经典玻尔兹曼方程和第一性原理计算，结合从头算分子动力学模拟，系统研究PtBi₂在电场下的线性和非线性输运响应。定量计算Edelstein效应和本征自旋霍尔效应，并分析单轴应变下Berry曲率偶极子诱导的非线性Hall效应。
AI.result: 发现PtBi₂具有高达800 K的居里温度；高温度顺电相可通过面内电导率简单测量来区分；表现出显著的电荷-自旋转换效率；单轴应变下出现Berry曲率偶极子诱导的非线性Hall效应；基于畴壁散射概念设计了具有非易失性高低阻态切换能力的FEM-FET。
AI.conclusion: 本文不仅揭示了二维铁电金属中丰富的输运物理，还为下一代非易失性存储器和自旋电子器件的设计提供了有价值的见解。

title: PACE-SIMS: Checkpoint-Gated Autonomous SIMS Characterization with AI-Agent Quality Control
summary: Time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometry (ToF-SIMS) is widely used for local chemical investigations across a broad range of materials and systems. However, its operation is expensive in expert time: a trained researcher must supervise acquisition throughout, dynamically tuning parameters throughout the experiment, often across a campaign spanning multiple days. Here, we present PACE-SIMS, an agentic workflow which runs a SIMS study as a human-AI collaboration. Here, the researcher specifies the scientific questions and quality requirements, and an AI agent builds the plan and, after approval, executes it autonomously, pausing at checkpoints to judge each measurement and to correct, retry, or escalate. To validate the approach, we applied it to a study of chemical composition in 18O-enriched WOx films. During this blind randomized, two-polarity study (8.1 hours, 35 measurements) the agent made three unscripted corrections a fixed script would have missed, and all four predictions held against the sealed ground truth. The same run returned transferable measurement science, including a composition calibration, a 5.3% isotope-reading offset between the two ion polarities, and the deposition's tracer-delivery mechanism, from less than two hours of researcher attention. The developed agentic architecture is not specific to SIMS and can be applied to other analytical techniques, with primary target being the destructive measurements for which optimization methods are poorly applicable.

AI.tldr: PACE-SIMS是一种基于AI智能体的工作流程，将飞行时间二次离子质谱（ToF-SIMS）研究转变为人类与AI的协作。研究者只需指定科学问题和质量要求，AI智能体自主构建计划并执行测量，在检查点暂停以判断每次测量、进行纠正、重试或上报。在18O富集WOx薄膜的化学成分研究中（8.1小时、35次测量），该智能体做出了三次固定脚本无法预见的修正，所有四个预测均与密封的真实结果吻合，且仅需不到两小时的专家注意力。该架构不局限于SIMS，可推广至其他分析技术，尤其适合难以应用优化方法的破坏性测量。
AI.motivation: ToF-SIMS在材料科学中应用广泛，但其运行耗费大量专家时间——训练有素的研究人员必须在整个实验过程中持续监督，动态调整参数，且实验常持续数天。这种高人力成本严重制约了该技术的通量与可用性，亟需一种自动化的智能工作流来减轻研究者负担。
AI.method: 提出PACE-SIMS智能体工作流：(1)研究者定义科学问题和质量要求；(2)AI智能体构建实验计划；(3)计划经研究者批准后自主执行；(4)在检查点暂停以评估每次测量，做出纠正、重试或上报决策。通过盲法随机双极性研究验证，应用于18O富集WOx薄膜的化学成分分析。
AI.result: 在8.1小时、35次测量的盲法随机双极性研究中，AI智能体做出三次固定脚本无法预见的修正；四个预测全部与密封的真实结果吻合；同时返回了可迁移的测量科学成果：成分校准、两离子极性间5.3%的同位素读数偏移，以及沉积物的示踪剂输送机制，仅需不到两小时的研究者注意力。
AI.conclusion: PACE-SIMS证明了智能体驱动的分析工作流能在显著降低专家时间投入的同时保持甚至提升测量质量，并产出可迁移的测量科学见解。该架构具有通用性，可推广至其他分析技术，尤其适用于难以引入优化方法的破坏性测量场景。
